title: Senegal’s Saint-Louis Regatta keeps centuries of tradition alive
english: Thousands of people recently gathered in Saint-Louis, Senegal, to participate in an annual traditional canoe race. This long-standing event serves as a celebration of the city's deep-rooted history and connection to the fishing industry. The regatta continues to be a vital cultural fixture that preserves local customs for future generations.
amharic: በሰኔጋል ሴንት-ሉዊስ ከተማ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የተሳተፉበት ዓመታዊ የጀልባ ውድድር ተካሄዷል። ይህ ለዘመናት የቆየ ባህላዊ ስነ-ስርዓት የከተማዋን የዓሣ ማጥመድ ታሪክ እና ማንነት የሚያንጸባርቅ ነው። ውድድሩ የአካባቢውን ወግ በመጠበቅ እና ለቀጣዩ ትውልድ በማስተላለፍ ረገድ ትልቅ ሚና ይጫወታል።
oromo: Magala Saint-Louis kan biyya Senegaal keessatti, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman duudha qomoo isaanii kan ta'e dorgommii doonii waggaa waggaan geggeeffamu irratti hirmaataniiru. Dorgommichi seenaa fi aadaa qurxummii qabuu kan magaalattiin qabdu ibsuuf gargaara. Ayyaanni kun aadaa fi duudhaa durii eeguuf akkasumas dhaloota dhufuuf dabarsuuf bakka olaanaa qaba.
