title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Hamas leader to push Gaza peace plan
english: US envoy Jared Kushner recently met with Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya in Egypt to discuss a peace proposal aimed at ending the conflict in Gaza. The US-backed plan calls for the disarmament of Hamas, the withdrawal of Israeli military forces, and a reconstruction effort under a new Palestinian civilian authority. While Israel has publicly rejected these terms until complete disarmament occurs, international mediators including Egypt, Qatar, and Turkey are continuing to push for the plan's implementation.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በጋዛ ያለውን ግጭት ለመፍታት የታቀደውን የሰላም እቅድ ለመወያየት በግብፅ ከሃማስ መሪ ካሊል አል-ሃያ ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። የአሜሪካው እቅድ የሃማስን ትጥቅ መፍታት፣ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከጋዛ መውጣት እና በጋዛ አዲስ ሲቪል አስተዳደር ማቋቋምን ያካትታል። እስራኤል የሃማስ ትጥቅ ሙሉ በሙሉ እስካልተፈታ ድረስ እቅዱን እንደማትቀበል ብትገልጽም፣ ዓለም አቀፍ አደራዳሪዎች ስምምነቱን ለማስፈጸም ጥረታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Ergamtooni Ameerikaa Jaared Kushner rakkoo Gaaza keessatti argamu furuuf karoorri nagaa qophaa'e akka hojiirra ooluuf biyya Gibxii keessatti geggeessaa Haamaas Kaalil al-Haayyaa wajjin mari'ataniiru. Karoorri Ameerikaan deggeramu kun hidhannoo Haamaas hiiksisuu, waraanni Israa'el Gaazaa gadi lakkisee akka ba'uu fi bulchiinsa siivilii haaraa dhaabuu kan of keessatti qabate dha. Israa'el hidhannoon Haamaas guutummaatti hinhikamin karooricha akka hin fudhanne ibsituus, biyyoonni giddu-galaan akka Gibxii, Qaatar fi Turkii mariin kun akka milkaa'uuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Erdogan says Israeli attacks on Lebanon are a serious concern for Türkiye
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has expressed significant apprehension regarding the ongoing military strikes by Israel against Lebanon. In a recent interview, he highlighted that these hostilities are a major cause of worry for the Turkish government. Erdogan's comments underscore Ankara's growing alarm over the potential for regional instability due to the escalating conflict.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶሃን በእስራኤል እና በሊባኖስ መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለው ወታደራዊ ግጭት ለቱርክ ትልቅ ስጋት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በቅርቡ ለአልጀዚራ በሰጡት ቃለ ምልልስ፣ የእስራኤል ጥቃቶች ቀጠናዊ ሰላምን አደጋ ላይ የሚጥሉ መሆናቸውን ጠቁመዋል። ይህም የቱርክ መንግስት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ስላለው ውጥረት ያለውን ከፍተኛ ስጋት ያሳያል።
oromo: Pireezidantiin biyya Turkii Rejeb Tayyib Erdogan, haleellaan Israa'el biyya Libaanoos irratti gaggeessaa jirtu biyyattii irratti yaaddoo guddaa akka uume ibsaniiru. Hirmaannaa gaaffii fi deebii dhaggeeffattootaaf taasisaniin, sochiiwwan waraanaa kun nagaa naannichaa miidhuu akka danda'an yaadachiisaniiru. Ibsi kun, mootummaan Turkii walitti bu'iinsa uumame kana ilaalchisee yaaddoo cimaa qabaachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Iran and Oman work on temporary Hormuz shipping route as Trump threatens to claim the strait
english: Iran and Oman are currently negotiating to create a temporary shipping lane through the Strait of Hormuz because the old paths are no longer usable. Iranian officials clarified that these discussions are focused on navigation logistics and are distinct from broader concerns regarding the potential closure or reopening of the waterway. They hope to finalize this interim arrangement soon before potentially establishing a permanent route in the future.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን ቀደም ሲል ይጠቀሙባቸው የነበሩት የባህር መስመሮች ስራ ላይ ስላልሆኑ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ጊዜያዊ የመርከብ መስመር ለመፍጠር እየተወያዩ ነው። የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር እንደገለጹት፣ እነዚህ ድርድሮች ከመተላለፊያው መዘጋት ወይም መከፈት ጉዳይ ጋር የተገናኙ አይደሉም። ሀገራቱ ይህንን ጊዜያዊ የመርከብ መንገድ በቅርቡ ለመጨረስ እና ለወደፊቱም ቋሚ መስመር ለመዘርጋት እቅድ አላቸው።
oromo: Iiraan fi Omaan daandiin markabootaa duraan itti fayyadamaa turan hojii ala waan ta'eef, karaa yeroo gabaabaa kan Hormuz irra deemuu danda'u uumuuf mari'achaa jiru. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iiraan akka ibsanitti, mariin kun dhimma daandii markabootaa qofa irratti kan xiyyeeffatu malee, dhimma cufiinsa ykn baninsa daandichaa wajjin wal qabatu miti. Gamachuun kun yeroodhaaf kan qophaa'e yoo ta'u, gara fuulduraatti gara daandii dhaabbataa tokkootti jijjiiruu akka danda'an ibsaniiru.

title: Hamas says it asked Board of Peace to 'compel' Israel to accept Gaza plan
english: Hamas has requested that the Board of Peace and international mediators force Israel to commit to a Gaza ceasefire agreement. Following a meeting with U.S. envoy Jared Kushner, the group urged for an immediate end to military operations and violations. They are specifically demanding that Israel fulfill its obligations from the first phase of the peace plan and agree to the roadmap for the next steps.
amharic: ሃማስ የሰላም ቦርዱና ዓለም አቀፍ አደራዳሪዎች እስራኤል በጋዛ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ እንድትገኝ ግፊት እንዲያደርጉ ጠይቋል። ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ልዑክ ጋር ከተወያየ በኋላ፣ ቡድኑ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችና ጥሰቶች እንዲቆሙ ጥሪ አቅርቧል። የሰላም እቅዱን የመጀመሪያ ምዕራፍ ተግባራዊ በማድረግ ረገድ እስራኤል ግዴታዋን እንድትወጣና ለቀጣዩ ምዕራፍ እንዲስማሙ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hamaas Boordii Nagaa fi giddu-galeessa biyyoota gidduu seenaniin, Israa'el walii galtee tasgabii Gaaza keessatti akka fudhattu dirqisiisuu akka qaban gaafate. Ergamaa Yunaayitid Isteetis waliin mari'achuu booda, gareen kun haleellaa fi dhiittaa waraanaa hatattamaan akka dhaabatu gaafate. Israa'el sagantaa nagaa sana keessatti dirqama ishee akka baatuu fi karoora fuulduraa irratti waliigaltee akka uuttu gorsa kennaniiru.

title: Kushner meets Hamas leaders in Egypt to push Trump’s Gaza plan
english: Jared Kushner held discussions with Hamas leaders in Egypt to advocate for a new Gaza peace proposal initiated by the Trump administration. The talks focused on securing the group's disarmament and ensuring they have no future governing role in the region. Despite opposition from Israeli leadership, the US delegation is attempting to establish verifiable steps to resolve the conflict and move toward a peace agreement.
amharic: ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር የቀረበውን አዲስ የጋዛ ሰላም እቅድ ለማስተዋወቅ በግብፅ ከሃማስ መሪዎች ጋር ተወያይተዋል። ንግግሮቹ ትኩረታቸውን ያደረጉት ቡድኑ ትጥቅ እንዲፈታ እና ወደፊት በጋዛ አስተዳደር ውስጥ ምንም አይነት ሚና እንዳይኖረው ለማድረግ ነው። የእስራኤል መንግስት እቅዱን ቢቃወመውም፣ የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ግጭቱን ለመፍታት እና ወደ ሰላም ስምምነት ለመድረስ ተጨባጭ እርምጃዎችን ለመውሰድ እየጣሩ ነው።
oromo: Jaared Kushner karoora nagaa Gaazaatiif mootummaan Donald Trump qopheesse beeksisuuf gibxitti hoogganoota Haamaas waliin mari'ateera. Mariin kun gareen sun meeshaa waraanaa akka hiikkatuufi gara fuulduraatti bulchiinsa Gaazaa keessatti qooda akka hin qabaanne taasisu irratti xiyyeeffata. Mootummaan Israa'el karoora kana kan mormu ta'us, ergamtoonni Ameerikaa walitti bu'iinsa jiru furuufi gara waliigaltee nagaatti dhufuu danda'an tarkaanfilee qabatamaa fudhachuuf carraaqaa jiru.

title: Erdogan calls for Strait of Hormuz reopening amid oil disruption
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has urged the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to ensure the stability of global oil supplies. He emphasized that both Turkey and Iran are in agreement regarding the necessity of maintaining the flow of petroleum through this critical maritime route. This call comes as tensions between the United States and Iran continue to pose a threat to international energy markets.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶጋን የአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት መረጋጋትን ለማረጋገጥ የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት እንደገና እንዲከፈት ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በዚሁ ወሳኝ የባህር መስመር የነዳጅ ዝውውር እንዲቀጥል ቱርክ እና ኢራን እንደሚስማሙ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጥሪ የተሰማው በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት በአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ ገበያ ላይ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ባለበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Turkii Rajab Xayyib Erdogaan dhiyeessii boba'aa addunyaa tasgabbeessuuf jecha, daandiin galaana Hormuz akka banamu gaafataniiru. Turkii fi Iraan daandiin galaanaa murteessaa ta'e kun boba'aa dabarsuu akka itti fufu irratti walii galuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Waamichi kun kan dhufe yeroo walitti bu'iinsi Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru gabaa anniisaa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jiruudha.

title: Teen suspect in Virginia campus shooting found hiding in closet
english: A 19-year-old suspect named Camron Harris has been arrested following a shooting at Virginia State University that left five people injured. Harris, who is not a student, was discovered by police hiding inside a closet on campus. While one victim remains in critical condition, the others are expected to survive their injuries.
amharic: ካምሮን ሃሪስ የተባለ የ19 ዓመት ወጣት በቨርጂኒያ ስቴት ዩኒቨርሲቲ በተፈጸመ የተኩስ አደጋ አምስት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረሱ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። የዩኒቨርሲቲው ተማሪ ያልሆነው ተጠርጣሪው በፖሊስ የተገኘው በግቢው ውስጥ በሚገኝ ቁም ሳጥን ውስጥ ተደብቆ ሳለ ነው። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል አንዱ አሁንም በከባድ ሁኔታ ላይ የሚገኝ ሲሆን ሌሎቹ አራቱ ግን ከሞት አደጋ ተርፈዋል።
oromo: dargaggeessi umriin isaa 19 kan ta'e Camron Harris jedhamu, Yuunivarsitii Steeti Vaarjiiniyaa keessatti namoota shan irratti dhukaasa banuun booda qabameera. Namni kun barataa yuunivarsichaa kan hin taane yoo ta'u, poolisoonni iddoo inni kuusaa uffataa keessatti dhokatee ture argatanii qabaniiru. Miidhamtoota shan keessaa tokko haala cimaa keessa yoo jiru, kaan garuu jireenyisaanii balaa keessa akka hin jirre ibsameera.

title: Remains of Palestinian teen shot by Israeli forces recovered in Gaza
english: The Palestinian Red Crescent Society successfully retrieved the body of 14-year-old Suhail Masoud Shalouf in southern Gaza. The teenager was fatally shot by Israeli military personnel while on al-Tina Street near Khan Younis. Local reports confirmed that his remains were collected following the incident on Saturday.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ቀይ ጨረቃ ማህበር በደቡባዊ ጋዛ የተገደለውን የ14 ዓመቱን ወጣት ሱሄል ማስኡድ ሻሉፍ አስከሬን ማግኘቱን አስታውቋል። ህጻኑ በካን ዩኒስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው አል-ቲና ጎዳና ላይ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ተኩስ መገደሉ ተገልጿል። አስከሬኑ በአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት አማካኝነት ከተገኘ በኋላ ለቀብር ስነ ስርዓት ተዘጋጅቷል።
oromo: Waldaan Gumaataa Diimaa Falasxiin reeffa dargaggeessa umuriin isaa 14 ta'e Suhayil Mas'uud Shaaluuf jedhamu kan ganda Gaazaa kibbaatti ajjeefame argachuu isaa beeksiseera. Dargaggeessi kun magaalaa Khan Yuunis cinaatti, karaa Al-Tiinaa jedhamutti waraana Israa'el irratti xiyyeeffatamee ajjeefame. Reeffi isaa kun guyyaa Dilbataatti garee gargaarsaatiin gadi baafameera.

title: Pope calls for end to Israeli violence against Palestinians in occupied West Bank
english: Pope Leo XIV has officially requested a halt to the ongoing violence directed at Palestinians living in the West Bank. He further urged global leaders to take immediate action to facilitate a two-state solution. This initiative aims to establish a fair and permanent peace in the region.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ ዐሥራ አራተኛ በዌስት ባንክ በሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን ጥቃት እንዲቆም ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ፍትሃዊ እና ዘላቂ ሰላም ለማምጣት የሚያስችለውን የሁለት ሀገር የመፍትሄ ሃሳብ እውን ለማድረግ እንዲንቀሳቀስ አሳስበዋል። ይህ ጥሪ ለክልሉ ዘላቂ መረጋጋት ወሳኝ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Papaa Liyo 14ffaan naannoo Weesti Baankitti ummata Falasxiin irratti haleellaan raawwatamaa jiru akka dhaabbatu waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Hawaasni idil-addunyaa biyyoota lamaa hundeessee nagaa waaraa fi haqa qabeessa ta'e fiduuf gargaarsa gochuu akka qabu dhaamaniiru. Yaanni kun nageenyi naannichaa akka mirkanaa'uuf xiyyeeffannoo barbaada.

title: Report: US envoy Kushner meets Hamas leaders in Egypt
english: Jared Kushner, serving as a U.S. envoy, held secret talks with Hamas officials in Egypt to discuss a peace proposal for Gaza. During the meeting, Kushner urged the group to disarm and give up its political authority in the region. Hamas representatives confirmed their stance on the deal while discussions remained focused on these contentious security and governance demands.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በጋዛ ስላለው የሰላም እቅድ ለመወያየት በግብፅ ከሃማስ መሪዎች ጋር በድብቅ ተገናኝተዋል። በስብሰባው ወቅት ኩሽነር ቡድኑ ትጥቁን እንዲፈታ እና በጋዛ አስተዳደር ውስጥ ያለውን ሚና እንዲያቆም ጫና ፈጥረዋል። የሃማስ መሪዎች በበኩላቸው በስምምነቱ ላይ ያላቸውን አቋም የገለፁ ሲሆን ውይይቱ በአስፈላጊ የደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር።
oromo: Ergamtoota Ameerikaa Jaared Kushner dhimma karoora nageenyaa Gaazaarratti mari'achuuf Gibxii keessatti hogganoota Hamaas waliin icciitiidhaan wal arguun isaanii gabaafame. Marii kana irratti Kushner gareen sun meeshaa waraanaa akka hiikkatuufi bulchiinsa Gaazaarratti qaban akka gadi lakkisan dhiibbaa godhaniiru. Gama biraatiin, bakka buutonni Hamaas wa'ee walii galtee sanaarratti qaban ibsuun, mariin kun dhimmoota nageenyaa xiyyeeffannoo guddaa barbaadanii irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture.

title: Israeli military attacks strategic hill in southern Lebanon
english: The Israeli military conducted an explosive attack on Ali al-Taher Hill in southern Lebanon. This location is considered a vital strategic position near the town of Nabatieh al-Fawqa. Local reports indicate that the area has recently experienced significant military engagement.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው አሊ አል-ታሄር ኮረብታ ላይ የቦምብ ጥቃት ፈጽሟል። ይህ ቦታ ናባቲያ አል-ፋውቃ በተባለች ከተማ አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ እና ከፍተኛ ስትራቴጂያዊ ጠቀሜታ ያለው ስፍራ ነው። በአካባቢው በቅርቡ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች እንደነበሩ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el gaara Ali al-Taher kan kibba Libaanoositti argamu irratti haleellaa boombii gaggeesseera. Iddoon kun magaalattii Nabatieh al-Fawqa biratti kan argamuufi bakka tarsiimoo cimaa qabu dha. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, naannichi kun yeroo dhihoo asitti haleellaa waraanaa cimaa keessa tureera.

title: Former Israeli captive asks Ben-Gvir to let him execute Palestinian prisone
english: Rom Braslavski, a former captive held in Israel, has requested permission from National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir to hang Palestinian prisoners. In response, Ben-Gvir expressed support for the idea, noting that carrying out such executions is among his primary personal goals. This exchange highlights growing tensions and extreme rhetoric surrounding the treatment of Palestinian detainees.
amharic: በእስራኤል ታግቶ የነበረው ሮም ብራስላቭስኪ፣ የሀገሪቱ የብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር የሆኑት ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር የፍልስጤም እስረኞችን በስቅላት እንዲገድል ፍቃድ እንዲሰጡት ጠይቋል። ሚኒስትሩ በበኩላቸው ጥያቄውን እንደሚደግፉት በመግለጽ፣ የፍልስጤም እስረኞችን መግደል የረጅም ጊዜ ህልማቸው መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። ይህ ክስተት በእስረኞች አያያዝ ዙሪያ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ውጥረት እና አደገኛ ንግግሮች የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Namni duraan Israa'el keessatti hidhatamee ture Rom Biraaslaavskiin, ministeera nageenyaa biyyaalessaa Israa'el Itaamar Been-Gviiriin hidhamtoota Filisxeemii akka inni fannisuuf heyyama akka kennuuf gaafate. Been-Gviirinis gaafficha akka deggaru ibsuun, hidhamtoota Filisxeemii ajjeesuun abjuu isaa inni guddaa ta'uu dubbate. Wal-dubbii kun haala hidhamtoota Filisxeemii irratti jeequmsi fi ibsotni hamoon akkamitti dabalaa akka jiran kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Israeli army besieges Palestinian homes in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli military forces have conducted a raid on the Palestinian village of Qusra, located in the occupied West Bank. Residents report that soldiers have occupied their private homes, effectively converting them into temporary military barracks. The situation highlights the ongoing tensions and the impact of military presence on local Palestinian households in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ በሚገኘው የኩስራ መንደር ላይ ወረራ ፈጽመዋል። የየአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እንደገለጹት ወታደሮቹ የግል ቤቶቻቸውን በመውረር ወደ ወታደራዊ ካምፕነት ቀይረዋቸዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በአካባቢው ያሉ ፍልስጤማውያን ቤተሰቦች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ተፅዕኖና ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el baatiiwwan darbanii waraana biyya Palestin kan taate Qusra, kan West Bank keessatti argamtu irratti duula gaggeessaniiru. Jiraattonni akka jedhanitti, loltoonni kunneen manneen isaanii dhuunfaa qabatanii gara buufata waraanaatti jijjiirrataniiru. Gochi kun rakkoo fi dhiibbaa waraanni Israa'el jiraattota Palestin irratti geessisaa jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: Why are sandwiches more regulated than AI?
english: MIT professor Max Tegmark argues that artificial intelligence currently lacks sufficient oversight compared to basic food safety regulations. He warns that powerful AI development is primarily driven by corporate greed and the pursuit of power rather than benefiting society. Concerns over the technology are mounting following reports of violent incidents linked to AI chatbots, sparking a call for stricter governmental control.
amharic: የኤም.አይ.ቲ ፕሮፌሰር ማክስ ቴግማርክ እንደሚሉት ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ከምግብ ደህንነት ደንቦች ጋር ሲነፃፀር በበቂ ሁኔታ ቁጥጥር አይደረግበትም። ቴክኖሎጂው ለህብረተሰብ ጥቅም ከመዋል ይልቅ ለጥቂት ባለሀብቶች ሀብትና ስልጣን ማከማቻነት እየዋለ መሆኑን ይገልጻሉ። በቅርቡ ከአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ጋር በተያያዙ የጥቃትና የራስ ማጥፋት ወንጀሎች ምክንያት፣ በቴክኖሎጂው ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ ግፊት እየተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Pirofesara MIT Maaks Teegmaark akka jedhutti, teeknolojii 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) irratti hordoffiin taasifamu kan nyaataaf taasifamu irra baay'ee laafaa dha. Teeknolojii kana guddifachuun bu'aa hawaasaaf osoo hin taane, fayyidaa fi aangoo namoota muraasaaf akka oolu yaaddoo qabu ibseera. Yeroo ammaa chat-bot AI waliin walqabatee gochaalee suukanneessaa fi of ajjeesuu mudate hordofee, mootummoonni teeknolojii kana irratti seera cimaa akka baasan gaaffiin guddaan jira.

title: ‘Water and salt’: Qusra residents trapped in Israeli settler siege
english: For over a week, fifteen Palestinians in the village of Qusra have been trapped in their homes due to a blockade enforced by Israeli settlers and military forces. The families are suffering from a severe lack of food, water, and power, as Israeli troops have actively blocked humanitarian aid from reaching them. Local officials describe the situation as a dire human rights crisis, noting that efforts to restore basic utilities have been forcefully stopped by those surrounding the area.
amharic: በኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ አስራ አምስት ፍልስጤማውያን እስራኤላዊያን ሰፋሪዎች እና ወታደሮች ባደረጉት ከበባ ምክንያት ከአንድ ሳምንት በላይ ቤታቸው ውስጥ ተጠልፈው ይገኛሉ። ቤተሰቦቹ በቂ ምግብ፣ ውሃ እና መብራት ሳያገኙ አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ያሉ ሲሆን የእስራኤል ወታደሮችም የሰብአዊ እርዳታ እንዳይደርስላቸው እያገዱ ይገኛሉ። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶችን ለመመለስ የተደረጉ ጥረቶች በከበባው ምክንያት ሳይሳኩ መቅረታቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ganda Qusraa keessatti warri Falasxiin kudhan shanii ol ta'an, loltoota Israa'elii fi qubsattootaan marsamanii torban tokkoo ol mana isaanii keessatti cufamanii jiru. Maatiin kun bishaan, elektirikii fi nyaata dhabuun rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru; loltoonni Israa'elis gargaarsi namoomaa akka isaan hin geenye ittisaa jiru. Hojjettoonni mootummaa naannichaa akka jedhanitti, haalli kun miidhaa mirga namoomaa hamaa ta'uu ibsuun, tajaajila bu'uuraa deebisanii dhaabuuf carraaqqii godhame hunduu haala kanaan gufatee jira.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo hints at retirement at end of season
english: Football superstar Cristiano Ronaldo has suggested that the current season may be the final one of his professional career. The 41-year-old Portuguese icon, who has achieved numerous records over two decades, plans to focus on his post-retirement life after reaching his goal of 1,000 career strikes. He expressed his intention to spend more time traveling and enjoying leisure activities once he departs from the sport.
amharic: የእግር ኳስ ኮከብ ክርስቲያኖ ሮናልዶ የአሁኑ የውድድር ዘመን የሙያ ህይወቱ የመጨረሻ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ፍንጭ ሰጥቷል። ለሁለት አስርት ዓመታት በርካታ ስኬቶችን ያስመዘገበው የ41 ዓመቱ የፖርቹጋል ተወላጅ፣ በሙያው 1,000 ግቦችን ከማሳካት ግቡ በኋላ ከሜዳ ለመሰናበት እቅድ አለው። ከእግር ኳስ ጡረታ ከወጣ በኋላ በጉዞ እና በተለያዩ መዝናኛዎች ጊዜውን ለማሳለፍ እንደሚፈልግ ገልጿል።
oromo: Leenjisaan kubbaa miilaa beekamaan Cristiano Ronaldo dararaa ykn tapha kubbaa miilaa bara kanaa booda akka dhaabu yaada isaa ibseera. Taphatichi umrii 41 kan ta'e kun, waggoota 20 oliif injifannoo gurguddoo galmeessise booda, goolii 1,000 galchuun hojii isaa xumuruuf karoora qaba. Tapha kana gad dhiisee boodas jireenya isaa kan itti fayyadamuufi imala adda addaa gochuun akka jiraatuuf hawwii isaa dubbateera.

title: Arsenal cruise to 3-0 win over Manchester City in Community Shield
english: Arsenal secured a dominant 3-0 victory over Manchester City to win the Community Shield, setting a strong tone for the upcoming Premier League season. Goals from Riccardo Calafiori, Kai Havertz, and Martin Odegaard overwhelmed City in manager Enzo Maresca's debut. This impressive performance highlighted the readiness of the defending champions as they aim to maintain their dominance in English football.
amharic: አርሰናል ማንቸስተር ሲቲን 3 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ የማህበረሰብ ጋሻውን (Community Shield) ዋንጫ ማንሳት ችሏል። ይህ ድል ለሚቀጥለው የፕሪሚየር ሊግ ውድድር አርሰናል ጠንካራ ዝግጁነት እንዳለው ያሳየበት ነው። ሪካርዶ ካላፊዮሪ፣ ካይ ሃቨርትዝ እና ማርቲን ኦዴጋርድ ግቦቹን ያስቆጠሩ ሲሆን፣ አዲሱ የሲቲ አሰልጣኝ ኤንዞ ማሬስካ በጀመሩበት የመጀመሪያ ጨዋታ ሽንፈት ገጥሟቸዋል።
oromo: Arsenal taphicha Community Shield irratti Manchester City 3-0 injifachuun xumureera. Injifannoon kun qophiin Arsenal darabaa liigii duraa irratti qabu cimaa akka ta'e kan agarsiisu dha. Goonni kanneen Riccardo Calafiori, Kai Havertz fi Martin Odegaard galchaniin, leenjisaa haaraa City Enzo Maresca'f jalqaba isaa kan ta'e injifannoo argachuun rakkisaa akka ta'e mul'iseera.

title: Two dead and evacuation under way as fires break out on Greek island
english: Two people have died and emergency evacuations are in progress following two simultaneous wildfires on the Greek island of Salamina. Nearly 200 firefighters, supported by aircraft and boats, are struggling to contain the blazes, which were intensified by strong winds. Authorities are working to prevent the fires from merging into one large disaster while coastal vessels help transport residents to safety.
amharic: በግሪክ ሳላሚና ደሴት ላይ በተቀሰቀሱ ሁለት የዱር እሳት አደጋዎች የሁለት ሰዎች ህይወት ማለፉን ተከትሎ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ለቀቃ እየተካሄደ ነው። ወደ 200 የሚጠጉ የእሳት አደጋ ተከላካዮች በአውሮፕላኖች እና በጀልባዎች ታግዘው የነደደውን እሳት ለመቆጣጠር እየታገሉ ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናት እሳቱ እንዳይቀላቀል እና ተጨማሪ ጉዳት እንዳያደርስ ለመከላከል እየሰሩ ሲሆን ነዋሪዎችንም በባህር በኩል ወደ ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ቦታ እያዘዋወሩ ነው።
oromo: Giraa guddaa biyya Giriik kan Salamina jedhamtu irratti ka'e lamaan hordofee lubbuun namoota lamaa darbeera, akkasumas namoota naannichaa gadi baasuun geggeeffamaa jira. Qaxxaamuraa abiddaa kana dhaamsuuf ibiddichi haalaan akka hin babal'anne tattaaffiin guddaan godhamaa jira. Duula kana keessatti ogeeyyonni dhaamsaa ibiddaa 200 ol, xiyyaarotaa fi dooniiwwan fayyadamuun lubbuu jiraattotaa baraaruuf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jiru.

title: Five Arab countries condemn Israel's rejection of Trump's Gaza plan
english: A group of nations including five Arab countries, Turkey, Pakistan, and Indonesia have formally denounced Israel for dismissing a peace proposal presented by President Donald Trump. These countries expressed concern that Israel's refusal to accept the plan undermines ongoing international attempts to halt the conflict in Gaza. The joint statement highlights the growing frustration among these nations regarding the current approach to ending the war.
amharic: አምስት የአረብ ሀገራት፣ ቱርክ፣ ፓኪስታን እና ኢንዶኔዢያ የእስራኤልን የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅድ መቃወም በጋራ አውግዘዋል። እነዚህ ሀገራት በእስራኤል በኩል የቀረበው ተቃውሞ በአካባቢው እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም የሚደረገውን ጥረት እንደሚያደናቅፍ ገልጸዋል። በጋራ ባወጡት መግለጫም የእስራኤል አቋም ቀጠናዊ ሰላምን አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥል ስጋታቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni shan kanneen Arabaa, Turkii, Paakistaanii fi Indooneezhiyaa, Israa'el karoora nagaa Gaazaaf dhihaate kan pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp mormuu ishee balaaleeffataniiru. Biyyoonni kun akka ibsanitti, Israa'el karoora kana fudhachuu diduun ishee, waraana Gaazaatti geggeeffamaa jiru dhaabsisuuf carraaqqii taasifamaa jiru gufachiisa. Ibsa gamtaa isaanii kanaan, gochi Israa'el kun nagaa naannichaa irratti miidha akka geessisu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Death toll increases in Lebanon since Israeli invasion
english: The Lebanese health ministry reports that over 4,300 people have been killed and 12,000 injured since Israel began its ground invasion on March 2. The casualties include hundreds of women, children, and medical personnel. Recent airstrikes in southern Lebanon have further increased the death toll, causing additional civilian losses.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ጤና ጥበቃ ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው፣ እስራኤል በመጋቢት 2 የጀመረችውን ወረራ ተከትሎ በሊባኖስ የደረሰው የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ4,346 በላይ ደርሷል። በግጭቱ ከ12,000 በላይ ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ ከሟቾች መካከል ሴቶች፣ ህጻናት እና የህክምና ባለሙያዎች ይገኙበታል። በቅርቡ በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በተፈጸሙ የአየር ጥቃቶች ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Ministeerri fayyaa Libaanoos akka ibsetti, Israa'el Muddee 2 irraa eegalee weerara gaggeessiteen namoonni 4,346 ol ajjeefamanii 12,000 ol madaa'aniiru. Miidhaa kanaan dubartoonni, daa'immanii fi hojjettoonnii fayyaa hedduun lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Guyyoota darban keessa weerara qilleensaa kibba Libaanoositti gaggeeffameen daa'imman dabalatee namoonni biroon du'aniiru.

title: Moroccan migrants stage sit-in as thousands remain stranded in Ceuta
english: Thousands of Moroccan migrants are currently stuck in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta following a major surge in arrivals two weeks ago. These individuals are staging protests and sit-ins to demand asylum while they remain in temporary shelters on the coast. Spanish officials are now reviewing their legal status to determine how to handle the ongoing humanitarian situation.
amharic: ከሁለት ሳምንት በፊት በስፔን ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው ሴኡታ በተፈጠረው ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች መጉረፍ ምክንያት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሞሮኳውያን ተስፈንጥረው ቀርተዋል። ስደተኞቹ በባህር ዳርቻዎች ላይ ጊዜያዊ መጠለያ በመያዝ ጥገኝነት እንዲሰጣቸው በሰልፍ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ። የስፔን ባለስልጣናት የእነዚህን ሰዎች የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ለመወሰን የጥገኝነት ጥያቄያቸውን እየመረመሩ ነው።
oromo: Godattoonni Morookoo kumaan lakka’aman torban lama dura gara magaalaa Ceuta kan Ispeen seente booda achumatti hafaniru. Namoonni kunneen bakka buufataalee yeroo qabatanii jiran yoo ta’u, eeyyama baqattummaa akka kennamuuf gaafachaa jiru. Aangoota Ispeen dhimma namoota kanaa ilaaluufi gaaffii isaan dhiheeffatan qorachaa jiru.

title: Largest Ukrainian drone attack on Russia, Moscow says 822 drones shot down
english: Ukraine recently conducted its most extensive drone offensive against Russian territory, resulting in at least six deaths. Russian authorities reported successfully intercepting 822 of the incoming drones. During the assault, a major logistics center operated by Wildberries located near Moscow was hit by the strikes.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ግዛት ላይ እስካሁን የታየ ትልቁን የድሮን ጥቃት የፈጸመች ሲሆን በድርጊቱም ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት በአጠቃላይ 822 ድሮኖችን መትተው መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በጥቃቱ ወቅት ሞስኮ አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ የዋይልድቤሪስ የሎጂስቲክስ ማዕከል መመታቱ ተሰምቷል።
oromo: Yukreeniin biyya Raashiyaatti haleellaa xiyyaara nama malee (droomii) baay'ina isaatiin guddaa ta'e raawwatte, kunis lubbuu namoota jahaa galaafateera. Mootummaan Raashiyaa xiyyaara droomii 822 ta'an akka balaliirra turanitti rukutanii kuffisuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Haleellaa kana keessatti, bakki qindoomina meeshaalee (logistics) kan Wildberries jedhamu kan Moskoo cinaatti argamu miidhaameera.

title: Centcom chief visits US carrier enforcing Iran blockade amid reports of severe strain on crew
english: Admiral Bradley Cooper of US Central Command recently visited the USS Abraham Lincoln, which is currently stationed in the Arabian Sea to enforce a blockade against Iran. The crew has been at sea for over 250 days without visiting a port, leading to growing concerns regarding their mental health and access to supplies. Admiral Cooper acknowledged the intensity of this mission, describing it as one of the most demanding deployments in recent times.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም አዛዥ አድሚራል ብራድሊ ኩፐር በኢራን ላይ የንግድ እገዳ ለማስፈጸም በአረብ ባህር የተሰማራውን የዩኤስኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከን አውሮፕላን ተሸካሚ መርከብ ጎብኝተዋል። መርከቧ ምንም ዓይነት ወደብ ሳይጠቀሙ ከ250 ቀናት በላይ በባህር ላይ በመቆየቷ በሰራተኞቹ ላይ የጤና እና የቁሳቁስ እጥረት ችግሮች ተፈጥረዋል። አድሚራሉ ይህ ተልዕኮ በዘመናዊ ታሪክ ውስጥ እጅግ አስቸጋሪ ከሆኑት መካከል አንዱ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan Komandii Giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (Centcom) Admiraal Biraadlii Kuupar, doonii xiyyaara baattu USS Abrahaam Liinkan kan galaana Arabaa keessatti Iran irratti uggura taasisuuf bobbaate daawwatan. Dooniin kun guyyoota 250 oliif utuu gara buufata tokkollee hin dhaabbatin galaana irra turuun isaa, hojjattoota irratti rakkoo fayyaa sammuu fi hanqina meeshaalee uumeera. Admiraalichi akka jedhanitti, bobboonni kun yeroo ammaa kanneen baay'ee ulfaataa ta'an keessaa isa tokko dha.

title: Iran and Oman work on temporary Hormuz shipping route as Trump threatens to claim the strait
english: Iran and Oman are collaborating to establish a temporary shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz to bypass current operational challenges. This initiative remains separate from the broader dispute over the full reopening of the waterway, which Iran insists depends on meeting specific conditions. These developments follow President Trump's recent threats to declare the strait as U.S. territory, a claim Iranian officials have firmly rejected as unrealistic.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በአሁኑ ወቅት የተስተጓጎለውን የሆርሙዝ ባህር ዳርቻ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ለማስቀጠል ጊዜያዊ የመርከብ መስመር ለመፍጠር እየተወያዩ ነው። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርድር መስመሩን ሙሉ በሙሉ ከመክፈት ጉዳይ ጋር የተለየ እንደሆነ ገልጸው፣ የውሃ መስመሩ ቁጥጥር አሁንም በኢራን እጅ መሆኑን አሳስበዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሆርሙዝን የባህር ዳርቻ የአሜሪካ ግዛት እንደሚያደርጉት ካስታወቁ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Iraanii fi Omaanni karaa markabaa yeroo gabaabaa ta'e kan Hormuz keessa darbu qopheessuuf mari'achaa jiru. Mariin kun balbala galaanaa kana guutummaatti banuu wajjin wal qabatee kan jiru miti, akkasumas Iraan mirga kan qabduu fi too'annoon ishee akka itti fufu ibsiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp daandii galaanaa kana kutaa biyya Ameerikaa akka godhatan doorsisanii booda dha.

title: Iranian parliament advances bill to curb foreign influence
english: The Iranian parliament has moved forward with legislation that aims to restrict communication with foreign entities deemed hostile to the state. Under this proposal, individuals could face prison time for speaking with outlets linked to the U.S. or Israel. Additionally, interacting with other foreign organizations or embassies would require official government authorization to avoid fines and legal penalties.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ ለሀገሪቱ ጠላት ናቸው ተብለው ከሚታሰቡ የውጭ ተቋማት ጋር የሚደረግ ግንኙነትን የሚገድብ ረቂቅ ህግ አጽድቋል። በዚህ ረቂቅ ህግ መሰረት፣ ከአሜሪካ ወይም ከእስራኤል ጋር ግንኙነት ካላቸው መገናኛ ብዙኃን ጋር መነጋገር እስከ ሁለት ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊያስቀጣ ይችላል። እንዲሁም ከሌሎች የውጭ ተቋማት ወይም ኤምባሲዎች ጋር ግንኙነት ለማድረግ የመንግስት ፈቃድ ማግኘት ግዴታ ይሆናል።
oromo: Paarlaamaan Iraan mootummaa isaanii irratti diina dha jedhanii kan amananii fi biyyoota alaa waliin quunnamtii taasisuu daangessuuf seera haaraa qopheessera. Seerri kun namoonni miidiyaalee Ameerikaa ykn Israa'el waliin walitti dhufeenya uuman hidhaa waggaa lamaa gahuun akka adabaman ni taasisa. Dabalataanis, dhaabbilee alaa fi embaasiiwwan biyyoota alaa waliin hojjechuuf hayyama mootummaa argachuun dirqama ta'a.

title: Centcom chief visits US carrier enforcing Iran blockade amid reports of severe strain on crew
english: Admiral Bradley Cooper of US Central Command visited the USS Abraham Lincoln, which has been stationed in the Arabian Sea for over 250 days to enforce a blockade against Iran. The extended mission has led to serious concerns regarding crew morale, mental health, and severe exhaustion, with reports of sailors attempting self-harm. In response to these mounting pressures, the US military plans to replace the vessel with the USS George Washington to allow for a necessary rotation.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ ዋና አዛዥ አድሚራል ብራድሊ ኩፐር፣ ኢራንን ለመዝጋት በአረብ ባህር ለ250 ቀናት በላይ የቆየውን USS አብርሃም ሊንከን የተባለ የጦር መርከብ ጎብኝተዋል። ረጅሙ የጦር ተልእኮ በመርከበኞች ላይ ከፍተኛ የሥነ ልቦና ጫና፣ ድካም እና የአእምሮ ጤና ችግሮች እንዲፈጠሩ ማድረጉ ተሰምቷል። ለዚህ ችግር ምላሽ ለመስጠት አሜሪካ መርከቧን በሌላ በመቀየር የመርከበኞቹን እረፍት ለማረጋገጥ አቅዳለች።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Ameerikaa (Centcom) Admiral Bradley Cooper, dooniin waraana USS Abraham Lincoln jedhamtu kan ji'oota hedduuf galaana Arabaa keessatti Iran ugguruuf qubatee ture daawwate. Hojiin kun kan dheeratee fi yeroo dheeraaf bakka bu'iinsa malee ture waan ta'eef, loltoota irratti rakkoo fayyaa sammuu fi dadhabbii cimaa hammaataa dhufeera. Haala rakkisaa kana keessatti, loltoonni of miidhuuf yaaluu isaanii kan gabaasame yoo ta'u, Ameerikaan doonii kana bakka buusuun loltoota haaraa gara sanatti erguuf karoorfatteetti.

title: Hamas leader meets Egyptian intelligence chief
english: A Hamas delegation led by Khalil al-Hayya recently met with Egypt's intelligence chief in El-Alamein to address post-war arrangements for Gaza. The group affirmed its willingness to follow the US-supported peace plan provided that Israel also adheres to the agreement. Furthermore, Hamas representatives intended to raise concerns regarding alleged Israeli breaches of the existing ceasefire.
amharic: የሃማስ ልዑካን ቡድን የጋዛን ከጦርነት በኋላ ያለውን ሁኔታ ለመወያየት በግብፅ ከሚገኘው የደኅንነት ዋና ዳይሬክተር ጋር ተገናኝቷል። ቡድኑ እስራኤል በተስማማችበት ሁኔታ የሰላም ዕቅዱን ለመተግበር ዝግጁ መሆኑን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም ሃማስ እስራኤል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን እየጣሰች መሆኑን ለግብፅ ባለሥልጣናት ለማሳወቅ አቅዷል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni garee Hamaas haala Gaza waraana boodaa irratti mari’achuuf qondaaltota basaasummaa Gibxii waliin wal arganiiru. Gareen kun, Israel walii galtee kanatti yoo hidhate, karooricha hojiirra oolchuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru. Kana malees, Hamaas gochoota Israel isheen walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa cabsite jechuun himate irratti ibsa kennuuf karoorfateera.

title: Hurricane Lala weakens to a tropical storm, but flooding persists in Hawaii
english: Hurricane Lala has downgraded to a tropical storm after passing near Hawaii, sparing the islands from a direct hit. Despite the change in status, the storm continues to cause dangerous flooding, severe winds, and power outages for tens of thousands of residents. Authorities remain on high alert due to the ongoing risks of mudslides, coastal erosion, and infrastructure damage across multiple islands.
amharic: አውሎ ንፋስ ላላ ወደ ትሮፒካል አውሎ ንፋስነት በመቀነሱ በሃዋይ ደሴቶች ላይ ሊደርስ የነበረውን ቀጥተኛ ጉዳት አስቀርቷል። ምንም እንኳን አውሎ ንፋሱ ቢዳከምም፣ አሁንም በደሴቲቱ ላይ ከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ፣ ኃይለኛ ነፋስ እና የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እያስከተለ ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ የመሬት መንሸራተት እና ሌሎች አደጋዎችን ለመከላከል ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እንዲደረግ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Hurricane Lala gara obomboleettii roobaatti erga gadi bu'ee booda, Hawaii irra balaa gurguddaa ga'uu danda'u irraa oolcheera. Haata'u malee, roobni cimaan, qilleensi humna qabuufi humna ibsaa kutuun ammas jiraattoota hedduu miidhaa jira. Bulchiistonni naannichaa, lolaa cimaa, biyyee socho'uufi miidhaa qabeenyaa kan biroo ittisuuf ummanni akka of eeggannoo godhu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: ‘The Mediterranean is a bridge, not a border’
english: Malta's Foreign Minister Chris Fearne argues that the Mediterranean should be viewed as a vital link between Europe and Africa rather than a divider. He calls for better European cooperation to manage migration and regional instability, including conflicts in Gaza, Ukraine, and Libya. Despite his commitment to international law, he cautions that the world is becoming increasingly dangerous and unpredictable.
amharic: የማልታ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ክሪስ ፈርን ሜዲትራኒያን ባህርን እንደ ድንበር ሳይሆን በአውሮፓና በአፍሪካ መካከል እንደ አገናኝ ድልድይ ሊታይ እንደሚገባ ይናገራሉ። ሚኒስትሩ የስደተኞች ችግርንና በጋዛ፣ በዩክሬን እና በሊቢያ ያሉ ግጭቶችን ለመፍታት አውሮፓ የተቀናጀ ጥረት እንድታደርግ አሳስበዋል። በአለም አቀፍ ህግ ላይ እምነት ቢኖራቸውም፣ ዓለማችን ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ ይበልጥ አደገኛ እየሆነች እንደመጣች አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Maaltaa, Kris Feern, garri Meditiraaneenii daangaa wal-gitu irra, daraja golaa kan biyyoota Awurooppaa fi Afriikaa walitti hidhu akka ta’e dubbatu. Rakkoolee godaantotaa fi jeequmsa naannoo kan akka Gaza, Yukreeni fi Liibiyaa furuuf Awurooppaan walitti dhufeenyaan hojjechuu akka qabdu dhaamaniiru. Seerri addunyaa akka kabajamu kan amanan ta’us, addunyaan ammaa kun gara fuulduraatti gara fuulduraatti yeroodhaa gara yerootti baay’ee sodaachisaa fi gaaffii keessa akka jirtu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Ben-Gvir calls for nightly killings of Palestinians in Gaza
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has publicly advocated for the nightly killing of dozens of Palestinians in Gaza. He described these individuals as being unworthy of life, marking another escalation in his ongoing efforts to intensify the hardships faced by Palestinians. This controversial statement reflects his extremist stance within the Israeli government regarding the conflict.
amharic: የእስራኤል ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር በጋዛ የሚገኙ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያንን በየሌሊቱ መግደል እንደሚያስፈልግ በይፋ ተናግረዋል። እነዚህ ሰዎች የመኖር መብት እንደሌላቸው የገለጹት ሚኒስትሩ፣ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን መከራ ለማባባስ ከሚያደርጉት ተከታታይ ጥረቶች መካከል ይህ አንዱ ነው። ይህ አወዛጋቢ አስተያየት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ግጭት ዙሪያ ያለውን እጅግ የከረረ አቋማቸውን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri nageenya biyyoolessaa Israa’el Itamaar Ben-Gviir, halkan halkan Gaza keessatti namoota hedduu ajjeesuun akka barbaachisu ifatti dubbataniiru. Namoonni kunneen jiraachuuf kan hin malleedha jechuun kan ibsan yoo ta'u, kunis rakkoo fi dhiphina ummata Falastiin irratti daranuu caalaatti jabeessuuf yaaliin godhamaa jiru keessaa isa tokko. Yaanni kunis lolli fi walitti bu'iinsi jiru daran akka hammatu gochuu danda'a.

title: What is Tokyo’s Yasukuni Shrine, linked to Japan’s wartime atrocities?
english: The Yasukuni Shrine in Tokyo is a memorial for millions of Japanese soldiers and civilians who died in various wars, including World War II. It remains a major source of international tension because it also honors 14 convicted war criminals responsible for atrocities during the imperial era. Because of this, visits by Japanese officials to the site often trigger protests from neighboring countries like China and South Korea, which argue that the shrine represents a failure to repent for wartime aggression.
amharic: በቶኪዮ የሚገኘው የያሱኩኒ ቤተመቅደስ በሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወቅት ለሞቱ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ የጃፓን ወታደሮች እና ሲቪሎች መታሰቢያ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ በጦር ወንጀል የተፈረደባቸው 14 ግለሰቦችም በውስጡ ስለሚታሰቡ፣ ቦታው ዓለም አቀፍ ውዝግብ ያስነሳል። የጃፓን ባለስልጣናት ይህን ቦታ መጎብኘታቸው የጦር ወንጀልን ባለመቀበል እና ያለፈውን የጭካኔ ድርጊት ችላ በማለት እንደ መቆጠሩ፣ እንደ ቻይና እና ደቡብ ኮሪያ ያሉ ጎረቤት አገራትን እያበሳጨ ይገኛል።
oromo: Masjiidni ykn bakki sagadaa Yaasukunii Tokiyo keessatti argamu kun, waraana addunyaa lammaffaa dabalatee waraana garaagaraa irratti namoota du'aniif yaadannoo kan ta'e dha. Haa ta'u malee, iddoon kun yakka waraanaatiin kan himataman namoota 14 waan of keessatti qabatuuf, iddoo mormii fi walitti bu'iinsa idil-addunyaa ta'eera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Jaappaan bakka kana daawwachuun isaanii, yakka waraana darbelerraatti gaabbuu dhabuu fi seenaa darbe akka tuffiitti waan fudhatamuuf, biyyoota ollaa akka Chaayinaa fi Kooriyaa Kibbaa biratti mormii cimaa uuma.

title: Who is DEI critic and Jason Arday accuser, Nathan Cofnas?
english: Nathan Cofnas is a critic of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiatives who identifies as a 'race realist.' He has recently gained attention for accusing Cambridge University professor Jason Arday of academic misconduct, including plagiarism and dishonesty. Cofnas holds controversial views, including the belief that intelligence levels differ based on racial identity.
amharic: ናታን ኮፍናስ የብዝሃነት፣ የእኩልነት እና የአካታችነት (DEI) ስራዎችን የሚተች እና ራሱን 'የዘር እውነታ ተከታይ' (race realist) ብሎ የሚጠራ ሰው ነው። በቅርቡ የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሮፌሰር የሆኑትን ጄሰን አርዳይን በምርምር ስርቆት እና በሐሰት ክስ በመወንጀል መነጋገሪያ ሆኗል። ኮፍናስ በተለያዩ የዘር ቡድኖች መካከል የአዕምሮ ብቃት ልዩነት አለ ብሎ የሚያምን አወዛጋቢ አመለካከት አለው።
oromo: Naatan Kofnaas namoota imaammata garaagarummaa, walqixxummaa fi hirmaachisummaa (DEI) morman keessaa tokko yoo ta'u, ofiisaa 'dhugaa-baatuu sanyii' jedhee waama. Innis piroofeesara Yuunivarsitii Kaambrijii Jeeson Ardaayiirratti himannaa yakka barnootaa fi soba dhiyeessuun xiyyeeffannaa argateera. Kofnaas yaada mormii guddaa kaasuu danda'u kan qabu yoo ta'u, keessattuu dandeettiin sammuu sanyiiwwan gidduutti garaagarummaa qaba jedhee amana.

title: Patients treated in tents after earthquake damages Indonesia hospital
english: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake has caused severe damage to a hospital in Indonesia, forcing medical staff to treat patients in temporary outdoor tents. The disaster has resulted in over 50 fatalities and left thousands of people without homes. Emergency responders and healthcare workers are currently struggling to provide care under these difficult conditions.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ የደረሰው የ7.7 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በሆስፒታል ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት በማድረሱ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ህሙማንን በድንኳን ውስጥ እንዲያክሙ አስገድዷቸዋል። አደጋው ከ50 በላይ ሰዎችን ሲገድል በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው አፈናቅሏል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞችና የጤና ባለሙያዎች አሁን ባለው አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ህክምና ለመስጠት እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Indoneziyaatti sochiin lafaa hamma 7.7 gahuun hospitaala tokko miidhuu isaatiin, ogeeyyonni fayyaa dhukkubsattoota mana jireenyaa ykn dunkaana keessatti yaaluuf dirqamaniiru. Balaa kanaan namoonni 50 ol lubbuun isaanii yoo darbu, kumaan kan lakkaa'aman immoo qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Hojjettoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa fi ogeeyyonni fayyaa haala rakkisaa kana keessatti tajaajila kennuuf dhama'aa jiru.

title: Houthis launch new attacks on al-Makha and Marib as Yemen conflict escalates
english: The Houthi group has intensified Yemen's long-standing conflict by launching a series of drone and missile strikes against Marib and the port city of al-Makha, resulting in multiple casualties and significant property damage. In response, the Yemeni military has conducted widespread operations against Houthi positions, further escalating tensions after a period of relative calm. These renewed hostilities mark a dangerous turn in a war that has persisted for nearly twelve years.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በማሪብ እና በአል-ማካ ከተሞች ላይ በድሮን እና በሚሳኤል ጥቃት በመሰንዘራቸው የየመን ግጭት ተባብሷል፤ ጥቃቱ በርካታ ሰዎችን ለህልፈትና ለጉዳት ከመዳረጉም በላይ የሲቪል መሰረተ ልማቶችን አውድሟል። ለዚህ ምላሽ የየመን መንግስት ወታደሮች በሁቲ አቋሞች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥቃት የሰነዘሩ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን አንጻራዊ ሰላም አደናቅፏል። ከአስራ ሁለት ዓመታት በላይ የዘለቀው ይህ የእርስ በእርስ ጦርነት በአሁኑ ወቅት ወደ ተባባሰ ደረጃ ተሸጋግሯል።
oromo: Houthonni magaala Maribii fi buufata doonii Al-Makhaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara raadaaraa fi misayilii geggeessuun, jeequmsi Yemen keessaa akka daran hammaatu godhaniiru. Haleellaa kanaan namoonni hedduun du'anii fi miidhaman, akkasumas qabeenyi namootaa barbadaa'eera. Mormii kanaaf, waraan yoon mootummaa Yemen mormituu irratti duula bal'aa banuun, tasgabbii turte akka wal-xaxu taasiseera. Waraanni waggoota kudha lamaan darban itti fufe kun, amma sadarkaa sodaachisaa irra ga'eera.

title: Timeline: The one-week siege of Qusra by Israeli settlers in the West Bank
english: Israeli settlers have been besieging Palestinian homes in the West Bank village of Qusra for a week, cutting off essential supplies like water and electricity. The Israeli military has declared the area a closed zone, forcing families out of their homes while preventing outside support. International bodies and officials have condemned these actions, which observers say follow a broader pattern of forced displacement of Palestinians in the occupied territories.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር በሚገኙ የፍልስጤማውያን መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ለአንድ ሳምንት የሚቆይ ከበባ በማድረግ፣ የውሃ እና የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎቶችን አቋርጠዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል አካባቢውን የተከለከለ ወታደራዊ ቀጠና በማወጅ ነዋሪዎችን ከቤታቸው እንዲወጡ ያስገደደ ሲሆን፣ እርዳታ የሚፈልጉ ሰዎችንም መድረስ አግዷል። ይህ ድርጊት በዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት የተወገዘ ሲሆን፣ በተያዙት ግዛቶች ውስጥ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የሚፈጸመው የመፈናቀል ዘመቻ አካል እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Qotee bulaan Israa'el ganda Qusraa kan West Bank keessatti argamuutti, manneen warra Falasxiin irratti marsaa guyyaa torbaaf kutaanii, bishaanii fi ibsaa irraa addan kutaniru. Waraanni Israa'el naannicha bakka waraanaa cufaa ta'e jechuun ibsuun, maatiiwwan mana isaanii gadi lakkisanii akka bahan dirqisiiseera akkasumas gargaarsi alaa akka hin geenye dhorkeera. Gochi kun dhaabbilee idil-addunyaatiin kan balaaleffatame yoo ta'u, kunis tarkaanfii Falasxiinota lafa isaanii irraa ari'uuf gaggeeffamu keessaa tokko akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Gaza genocide: How Israel made horror a ritual of daily life
english: The ongoing violence in Gaza has transformed the daily lives of Palestinians into a continuous cycle of suffering and tragedy. Families are frequently left unable to recover the bodies of loved ones buried beneath destroyed buildings. This state of constant brutality has profoundly impacted every aspect of the population's existence while the international community watches.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት የፍልስጤማውያንን የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮ ወደማያቋርጥ ስቃይና መከራ ቀይሮታል። ቤተሰቦች በፍርስራሽ ስር የተቀበሩ የሚወዷቸውን ሰዎች አስከሬን ማውጣት ተስኗቸው በከፍተኛ መከራ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ዘግናኝ እልቂት የህዝቡን የኑሮ ዘይቤ ሙሉ በሙሉ በመለወጥ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ እየተመለከተው ከፍተኛ ሰብዓዊ ቀውስ አስከትሏል።
oromo: Waraanni fi haleellaan gaaza keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru jireenya guyyaa guyyaa namoota achi jiraatanii gara gadadoo fi gidiraa itti fufinsa qabutti jijjiiree jira. Maatiin hedduun reeffa namoota isaanii gamoo diigame jala jiru baasachuu dadhabuun gadda guddaa keessa jiru. Rokkeen kun jireenya ummataa hundarratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisaa yoo ta'u, haalli kunis addunyaan hundi akka arguuf ta'eera.

title: Gaza genocide: How Israel made horror a ritual of daily life
english: In the Gaza Strip, ongoing military actions have turned daily life into a constant struggle for survival for its 2.4 million residents. People live under the persistent, threatening sound of Israeli military drones, which monitor the population and create an atmosphere of relentless psychological terror. With nowhere safe to hide, children and families face the constant fear of sudden bombardment, marking a tragic and brutal reality sustained by modern weaponry.
amharic: በጋዛ ሰርጥ የሚኖሩ 2.4 ሚሊዮን ነዋሪዎች ቀጣይነት ባለው ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የዕለት ተዕለት ህይወታቸውን በስጋት እያሳለፉ ይገኛሉ። የእስራኤል ድሮኖች በየጊዜው በሰማይ ላይ በመንቀሳቀስ ነዋሪዎችን በመከታተል ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ጫና እና ፍርሃት ይፈጥራሉ። ህፃናት እና ቤተሰቦች በማንኛውም ሰዓት ሊከሰት የሚችል የቦምብ ጥቃት በመፍራት በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ሳይሆኑ በከፍተኛ ስቃይ ውስጥ ይኖራሉ።
oromo: Godina Gaazaatti namoonni miliyoona 2.4 ta'an duula waraanaa ittifufiinsa qabu keessatti jireenya guyyuu isaanii sodaa guddaa keessa dabarsaa jiru. Xiyyaarotni daayiloota (drones) Israa'el guyyaa fi halkan samii irra naanna'uun ummata hordofaa jiraachuun isaanii, yaaddoo fi sodaa hamtuu uumeera. Bakki nageenyaa waan hin jirreef, ijoolleenii fi maatiin yeroo kamiyyuu haleellaa boombii isaan mudachuu danda'u sodachuun, jireenya hamaa keessa jiraachuuf dirqamaniiru.

title: Belgium’s largest wildfire on record spreads towards German border
english: Belgium is currently fighting its biggest wildfire on record, which has consumed over 27 square kilometers of the High Fens nature reserve. Fire crews from several neighboring countries are assisting local authorities to stop the flames from reaching the German border. While hundreds of residents have been evacuated due to smoke and fire risks, officials remain hopeful that the blaze will be contained before it crosses into Germany.
amharic: ቤልጂየም እስካሁን ካጋጠማት ትልቁ የሰደድ እሳት ጋር እየታገለች ሲሆን እሳቱ ከ27 ስኩዌር ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ የሚሸፍን የተፈጥሮ መጠለያ ቦታ አውድሟል። እሳቱ ወደ ጀርመን ድንበር እንዳይሻገር ለመከላከል ከአጎራባች ሀገራት የተውጣጡ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞች ከቤልጂየም አቻዎቻቸው ጋር በመሆን ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። በጭስ እና በእሳት ስጋት ምክንያት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲለቁ የተደረገ ቢሆንም፣ ባለስልጣናት እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Beljiyeem boba'aa bosonaa seenaa ishee keessatti mudate isa guddaa wajjin qabsoo gochaa jirti; boba'aan kun lafa heektaara 27 ol ta'u kan gubee dha. Ibiddichi gara daangaa Jarmanii akka hin ceeneef, gargaartonni dhaabbata boba'aa biyyoota ollaa irraa dhufan humnoota biyyattii wajjin ta'uun dhaabuuf tattaafachaa jiru. Aaran boba'aa sanaa fi balaa isaa irraa kan ka'e namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman qe'ee isaanii gadi lakkisanii ba'us, qaamoleen mootummaa ibiddicha to'achuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: Israeli settlers pray in Al-Aqsa Mosque complex
english: Over 150 Israeli settlers entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound and held prayer services while guarded by police. This action violates the longstanding agreement that designates the site exclusively for Muslim worship. Such incidents of settlers breaking the established status quo at the holy site have become more frequent lately.
amharic: ከ150 በላይ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በፖሊስ ታጅበው ወደ አል-አቅሳ መስጊድ ግቢ በመግባት የጸሎት ስነ-ስርዓት ፈጽመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት መስጊዱ ለሙስሊሞች ብቻ የተፈቀደ የጸሎት ቦታ መሆኑን የሚደነግገውን የቆየ ስምምነት የሚጥስ ነው። በቅርብ ጊዜያት ውስጥ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በኩል ይህን የተከበረ ስፍራ ህግ የመጣስ ድርጊቶች እየተበራከቱ መጥተዋል።
oromo: Namoonni biyya Israa'el irraa dhufan 150 ol ta'an, poolisootaan eegamaa gara dirree masjiida Al-Aqsa seenuun kadhannaa geggeessaniiru. Gochi kun, dirreen kun kan musullimoota qofa akka ta'e kan ibsu waliigaltee waggoota dheeraa ture cabsuu dha. Yeroo dhihoo asitti, namoonni kunneen masjiida kana keessatti seera darbuudhaan kadhachuu isaanii hordofee walitti buutiin akkasii dabalaa dhufeera.

title: Iran war pushes Middle Eastern airlines towards $4.3bn loss in 2026
english: Escalating military conflict between Iran, the US, and Israel has caused major disruptions to Middle Eastern aviation, leading to significant financial losses projected at $4.3 billion for 2026. Frequent airspace closures, decreased passenger demand, and higher fuel costs have forced regional carriers to operate at reduced capacity. Additionally, many international airlines have suspended their services to the Gulf, severely impacting the region's traditional hub-and-spoke business model.
amharic: በኢራን፣ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል መካከል ያለው ወታደራዊ ግጭት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የአቪዬሽን ዘርፍ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት በማድረሱ በ2026 የ4.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ኪሳራ እንደሚገመት ታውቋል። የአየር ክልል በተደጋጋሚ መዘጋት፣ የተሳፋሪዎች መቀነስ እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ መጨመር የአካባቢውን አየር መንገዶች አቅማቸውን እንዲቀንሱ አስገድዷቸዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በርካታ ዓለም አቀፍ አየር መንገዶች ወደ መካከለኛው ምስራቅ የሚያደርጉትን በረራ ማቆማቸው የክልሉን የአቪዬሽን ንግድ ስትራቴጂ ከፍተኛ ፈተና ውስጥ ከቷል።
oromo: Gidduu galeessa bahaatti waraanni Iran, US fi Israa'el gidduutti ka'e damee xiyyaaraa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira; kunis bara 2026 tti hojii irraa miidhaa doolaara biliyoona 4.3 ta'u akka qaqqabsiisu tilmaamameera. Cufamuu bakka balalii, hir'ina imaltootaa fi gatii boba'aa dabaleen walqabatee, kampaanonni xiyyaaraa naannichaa guutummaan hojjechuu dadhabaniiru. Kana malees, kampaanonni xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa hedduun gara naannichatti balalii dhaabuu isaaniitiin, mala daldalaan naannichi ittiin beekamu hubameera.

title: West Bank homes left without water or electricity
english: Three residential properties in the West Bank town of Qusra are currently enduring a siege without access to electricity or water. Local leadership stated that Israeli military forces are actively blocking repair crews and activists from assisting those trapped inside. The situation remains critical as outside help is being denied access to the affected families.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ ከተማ የሚገኙ ሶስት ቤቶች የኤሌክትሪክ እና የውሃ አገልግሎት በማቋረጡ አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የከተማዋ ከንቲባ እንደገለጹት፣ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች የጥገና ባለሙያዎች እና አክቲቪስቶች ቤቶቹ ጋር እንዳይደርሱ በመከልከላቸው ነዋሪዎቹ እርዳታ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። ሁኔታው አሳሳቢ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Magaalaa Qusraa kan West Bank keessatti, manni jireenyaa sadii bishaanii fi elektirikii malee rakkina cimaa keessa jiru. Kantiibaan magaalattii akka ibsanitti, waraanni Israa'el gareewwan gargaarsaa fi ogeeyyiin suphuu akka iddoo sana hin geenye dhoorkaa jiru. Sababa kanaan namootni manneen sana keessatti hafan gargaarsa barbaachisu argachuu hin dandeenye.

title: ‘Spearhead of annexation’: Israel hands West Bank rule to civilian police
english: The Israeli government has decided to move civilian law enforcement in the occupied West Bank from the military to the national police force. Critics and Palestinian officials argue this shift is a strategic move to formalize the annexation of the territory and strengthen the influence of armed settler groups. By replacing military oversight with civilian authority, experts warn that Israel is deepening its apartheid policies and further marginalizing the Palestinian population.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የሲቪል ህግ ማስከበር ስራን ከወታደራዊ አካላት ወደ ብሄራዊ ፖሊስ ሃይል ለማዛወር ወስኗል። ተቺዎች እና የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ይህ እርምጃ ግዛቱን ለመቀላቀል እና የታጠቁ ሰፋሪዎችን ተፅእኖ ለመጨመር የተደረገ ስልታዊ እንቅስቃሴ ነው ብለው ያምናሉ። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ይህ የህግ አወቃቀር ለውጥ የእስራኤልን የአፓርታይድ ፖሊሲዎች በማጠናከር በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የሚፈፀመውን ጥቃት የበለጠ ሊያባብሰው ይችላል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa Dhiha (West Bank) keessatti hojiin nageenyaa eeguu fi seera kabachiisuu harka waraanaarraa gara poolisii biyyaalessatti akka darbu murteesseera. Murtii kana kan morman qaoleen fi hoggantoonni Falasxiin, tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii ofitti makuu fi garee qotee bulaa hidhataniif carraa bal'aa kennuuf kan qophaaye dha jedhu. Ogeeyyiin akka ibsanitti, jijjiiramni seeraa kun sirna 'apartheid' Israa'el cimsuu fi uummata Falasxiin miidhuu keessatti gahee olaanaa qaba jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Europe's tallest Virgin Mary statue unveiled in rural Poland
english: A massive 55.6-meter statue of the Virgin Mary has been inaugurated in the rural Polish village of Konotopie. Commissioned by a local wealthy couple, the monument stands taller than Brazil's famous Christ the Redeemer. The consecration ceremony took place during the Feast of the Assumption, serving as a symbolic reminder of faith in a country where the influence of the Catholic Church is currently fading.
amharic: በፖላንድ ገጠራማ አካባቢ በምትገኝ ኮኖቶፒ በተባለች መንደር የድንግል ማርያም ግዙፍ ምስል ተመረቀ። 55.6 ሜትር ከፍታ ያለው ይህ ሐውልት በሀገር ውስጥ ሀብታም ጥንዶች የተገነባ ሲሆን ከታዋቂው የብራዚሉ የክርስቶስ ምስል ይበልጣል። የምርቃት ስነስርዓቱ የተካሄደው በኦርቶዶክስ እምነት ተከታዮች የዕርገት በዓል ወቅት ሲሆን፣ በሀገሪቱ የካቶሊክ ቤተክርስቲያን ተጽዕኖ እየቀነሰ በመጣበት በዚህ ወቅት ሃይማኖታዊ ትኩረትን ለመሳብ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaa Poolaandi baadiyaa Konotopie jedhamtutti, fakkii Waaqayyoo kan taate durbee Maariyaamii kan guddina meetira 55.6 qabu tokko eebbifamee jira. Fakkichi kan ijaarame qabeenyaa namoota sooressa biyya sanaatiin yoo ta'u, dheerinna isaas fakkii Kiristoos isa Biraazilitti argamu caala. Eebbi fakkichaa guyyaa ayyaana olba'iinsa Maariyaamii irratti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, kunis dhiibbaan waldaa Kaatolikii biyyattii keessatti hir'achaa dhufuun isaa hubatamee, amantootaaf yaadachiisa akka ta'uuf yaadamee kan ijaarame dha.

title: ‘Limited options’ for many Iranians as war with US chokes economy
english: The ongoing military conflict between Iran and the United States has severely damaged the Iranian economy, leading to extreme financial hardship for the population. Citizens are struggling with skyrocketing prices for essential food items and housing, while salaries remain very low, often falling below the minimum wage. Many educated professionals are now forced to take grueling, low-paying jobs just to afford basic necessities as job security continues to decline.
amharic: በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው ቀጣይ ግጭት የኢራንን ኢኮኖሚ በእጅጉ በመጉዳቱ ህዝቡ ለከፍተኛ የኑሮ ውድነት ተዳርጓል። የምግብ እና የመኖሪያ ቤት ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየጨመረ ቢሆንም፣ የሰራተኞች ደሞዝ ግን ዝቅተኛ ሆኖ በመቀጠሉ ብዙዎች መሠረታዊ ፍላጎቶቻቸውን ማሟላት ተስኗቸዋል። የተማሩ ወጣቶች ሳይቀሩ መተዳደሪያቸውን ለማግኘት ሲሉ ብቻ ከትምህርታቸው ውጪ ባሉ አስቸጋሪ እና ዝቅተኛ ክፍያ በሚሰጡ ስራዎች ላይ ለመሰማራት ተገደዋል።
oromo: Waraanni biyyoota Iran fi Ameerikaa gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru diinagdee Iran irratti dhiibbaa cimaa geessiseera. Gatiin meeshaalee bu'uuraa fi mana jireenyaa dabaluun, akkasumas mindaan hojjettootaa gadi bu'aa ta'uun isaa jiraattoonni jireenya guyyaa guyyaa isaanii akka hin dandeenye godheera. Namoonni beekumsa qaban illee, jireenya isaanii jiraachuuf jecha hojiiwwan mindaa gad aanaa fi hojii cimaa ta'an hojjechuuf dirqamaa jiru.

title: Trump threatens to make the Strait of Hormuz a US territory: Can he?
english: President Donald Trump recently claimed he would designate the Strait of Hormuz as U.S. territory following the ongoing conflict with Iran. Experts suggest this rhetoric is likely a political tactic intended to pressure Tehran rather than a serious legal or territorial claim. In reality, the waterway is recognized internationally as the territorial waters of Iran and Oman, despite the current U.S.-led naval blockade.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአይራን ጋር እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት ሳቢያ የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን የአሜሪካ ግዛት እንደሚያደርጉት በቅርቡ ተናግረዋል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ይህ ንግግር ህጋዊ መሰረት ያለው ሳይሆን አይራን ላይ ጫና ለመፍጠር የሚደረግ የፖለቲካ ብልሃት ነው። ምንም እንኳን አሜሪካ የባህር ላይ እገዳ ብትጥልም፣ ይህ የውሃ መስመር በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የአይራን እና የኦማን ግዛት ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Pireezidanti Doonaald Tiraamp, waraana Iran waliin gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee, daandii bishaan galaana Hormuz kan Ameerikaa akka ta'u ibsaniiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, yaanni kun kan qabatamaa miti; kanaa mannaa Iran irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf tooftaa siyaasaa kan itti fayyadamanidha. Ameerikaan to'annoo galaanaa taasiftus, daandiin bishaan kun seera idil-addunyaatiin kan Iran fi Omaanii akka ta'e beekama.

title: Arsenal vs Manchester City LIVE: FA Community Shield
english: Arsenal and Manchester City are facing off in the FA Community Shield at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff. This highly anticipated match marks the competitive managerial debut for Enzo Maresca following Pep Guardiola’s exit from Manchester City. The game is scheduled to begin at 3:00 PM local time.
amharic: አርሰናል እና ማንቸስተር ሲቲ በካርዲፍ በሚገኘው ፕሪንሲፓሊቲ ስታዲየም የኤፍኤ ኮሚኒቲ ሺልድ ዋንጫን ለማሸነፍ ይፋለማሉ። ይህ ጨዋታ ፔፕ ጋርዲዮላ ከለቀቁ በኋላ ኤንዞ ማሬስካ የማንቸስተር ሲቲ አሰልጣኝ ሆነው በይፋ የሚመሩበት የመጀመሪያው ውድድር ነው። ጨዋታው በሀገር ውስጥ ሰዓት አቆጣጠር ከቀኑ 9 ሰዓት ላይ ይጀመራል።
oromo: Arsenal fi Manchester City waancaa FA Community Shield irratti buufata Principality Stadium kan Cardiff keessatti wal morkatu. Taphi kun erga Pep Guardiola deemee booda Enzo Marescan leenjisaa Manchester City ta'ee tapha dorgommii isaa jalqabaa irratti hirmaatu dha. Taphi kun sa'aatii 9:00tti kan eegalu ta'a.

title: Why has Israel escalated attacks in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire?
english: Israel recently launched intensified air strikes in southern Lebanon, killing at least 11 people, including children, despite ongoing ceasefire agreements brokered by the United States. These attacks have targeted areas previously considered safe, leading to significant destruction of towns and residential buildings. Although Lebanon and Israel have negotiated multiple truces since June, the violence continues as Israel expands its military presence and Hezbollah remains in opposition to the terms of the deals.
amharic: እስራኤል በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የተደረጉ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶች ቢኖሩም በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ላይ ጥቃቷን በማጠናከሯ ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቶቹ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ንፁሃን ላይ የደረሱ ሲሆን ቀደም ሲል ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ነው ተብሎ ይታሰብ የነበረውን አካባቢ ጭምር አውድመዋል። ምንም እንኳን ሊባኖስ እና እስራኤል ከሰኔ ወር ወዲህ በተደጋጋሚ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶችን ቢፈራረሙም፣ እስራኤል ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዋን በማስፋፋቷ ግጭቱ ሳይበርድ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Israa'el giddugalaan Ameerikaa waliigaltee dhaabbata waraanaa irratti walii galtees, kibba Libaanoos irratti haleellaa jabeessitee raawwattee jiraattota 11 ol ajjeeftee jirti. Haleellaan kun ijoollee dabalatee namoota hedduu irratti kan miidhe yoo ta'u, bakka kanaan dura nagaa ture jedhamee yaadamu kan gubee fi mancaase dha. Libaanoos fi Israa'el ji'a Waxabajjii irraa jalqabee walii galtee tasgabbii hedduu mallatteessanis, Israa'el qarqara waraanaa ishee babal'isuu fi gareen Hizbullaahis walii galtee kana mormuun isaa waraanni sun akka itti fufu taasiseera.

title: Houthi missile barrage hits Mocha port as fighting escalates in Yemen
english: Houthi forces have launched a series of missile and drone attacks against the Yemeni city of Marib and the port of Mocha, marking a significant escalation in violence. These strikes have caused civilian casualties, damaged critical infrastructure, and resulted in the suspension of all commercial activities at Mocha port. These ongoing hostilities have disrupted the long-standing truce, creating a humanitarian crisis and causing severe economic losses for local workers.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ማሪብ ከተማ እና በሞቻ ወደብ ላይ ተከታታይ የሚሳኤል እና የድሮን ጥቃቶችን በማድረስ ግጭቱን አባብሰዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በሲቪል ነዋሪዎች ላይ ጉዳት ከማድረሳቸውም በላይ መሰረተ ልማቶችን አውድመው የሞቻ ወደብ የንግድ ስራ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲቋረጥ አስገድደዋል። ይህ ከ2022 ወዲህ የቆየውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት በመጣስ የሰብአዊ ቀውስን ከመፍጠሩም በላይ ለብዙ ሰራተኞች የገቢ ምንጭ መጥፋት ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Humni Huthotaa magaalaa Maariib fi buufata doonii Mochaa irratti haleellaa rooba miisa'elii fi dooniiwwan of danda'anii balali'an (drones) raawwachuun waraana sana daran hammaachiseera. Haleellaan kun lubbuu namootaa galaafachuu fi miidhaa qabeenyaa irraan ga'uun ala, hojii daldalaa buufata Mochaa guutummaatti dhaabsiiseera. Gochi kun walii galtee waraana dhaabuu waggoota darban ture kan cabse yoo ta'u, rakkoo namoomaa uumuu fi hojjettoota baay'eef miidhaa dinagdee guddaa fideera.

title: Premier League: Key talking points heading into the new 2026-27 season
english: The 2026-27 Premier League season begins on August 21 with Arsenal aiming to defend their title for the first time in nearly a century. Major managerial changes highlight the new campaign, with Enzo Maresca taking over at Manchester City following Pep Guardiola’s departure and Xabi Alonso arriving at Chelsea. Teams have been busy strengthening their squads, notably with Arsenal signing Bruno Guimaraes, as clubs navigate the challenges of a busy summer schedule.
amharic: የ2026-27 የፕሪሚየር ሊግ የውድድር ዘመን ነሐሴ 21 ቀን የሚጀመር ሲሆን፣ አርሰናል ከዘጠና ዓመታት በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ዋንጫውን ለማቆየት ይሞክራል። የፔፕ ጋርዲዮላን መነሳት ተከትሎ ኢንዞ ማሬስካ የማንቸስተር ሲቲን፣ ዣቢ አሎንሶ ደግሞ የቼልሲን ዋና አሰልጣኝነት በመረከብ ትልቅ ለውጥ ታይቷል። ክለቦች አዲሱን የውድድር ዘመን በጉጉት ሲጠብቁ፣ አርሰናል ብሩኖ ጊማሬስን ጨምሮ አዳዲስ ተጫዋቾችን ወደ ስብስቡ በመቀላቀል ቡድኑን ለማጠናከር ጥረት አድርጓል።
oromo: Barri tapha Premier League bara 2026-27 Hagayya 21 kan jalqabu yoo ta'u, Arsenal waggaa 90 keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf qophiin ishee waancicha ittisuudha. Jijjiirraan leenjistoota guguddaa kanneen akka Enzo Maresca Man City fi Xabi Alonso Chelsea fudhachuu isaanii, akkasumas Arsenal taphataa Bruno Guimaraes mallatteessuun ishee xiyyeeffannoo kutaalee kanaa ti. Gareewwan hundi xumura qophii isaanii booda, injifannoo argachuuf kaka'umsa guddaa qabachuu isaanii ibsameera.

title: Doctor describes amputating girl’s leg in Gaza without anaesthesia
english: Orthopedic surgeon Mark Perlmutter reported performing an emergency leg amputation on a five-year-old girl in Gaza without the use of anaesthesia due to critical supply shortages. To help the child endure the pain during the operation, medical staff sang to her while she remained conscious. This account highlights the dire medical conditions and lack of essential resources faced by healthcare workers in the region.
amharic: የአጥንት ህክምና ባለሙያው ማርክ ፐርልሙተር በጋዛ የህክምና ቁሳቁስ እጥረት ምክንያት የአምስት ዓመት ህጻን እግር ያለ ማደንዘዣ መቁረጣቸውን ገልጸዋል። ህጻኗ በቀዶ ጥገናው ወቅት ህመሙን እንድትቋቋም ለማገዝ የህክምና ባለሙያዎቹ እሷን ለማረጋጋት ዘፈን ዘምረውላታል። ይህ ክስተት በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በክልሉ የሚገኙ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች እየገጠማቸው ያለውን አስከፊ ሁኔታ እና የመድሃኒት እጥረትን ያሳያል።
oromo: Ogeessi fayyaa lafee Mark Perlmutter, gaza keessatti sababa dhabama qoricha kahuutiin mucayyoo waggaa shanitii miila ishee qoricha malee akka irraa muran ibseera. Yeroo baqaqsanii hodhuu kanatti miira dhukkubbii ishee hir'isuuf, ogeeyyonni fayyaa ishee gammachiisuuf sagalee ishee biratti sirba sirbanii turan. Gochi kun haala gaddisiisaa fi hanqina meeshaalee yaalaa naannoo waraanaan miidhame keessatti ogeeyyonni fayyaa keessa jiran kan agarsiisuudha.

title: The post-Hormuz era offers Africa a great opportunity
english: Global maritime disruptions, such as those at the Strait of Hormuz, have negatively impacted African economies that are overly dependent on global supply chains. To move past this vulnerability, Africa must shift its strategic focus from land-based security to a robust, unified maritime policy. By overcoming historical divisions and pooling resources, the continent can transform from a passive resource supplier into a major geopolitical power.
amharic: እንደ ሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ባሉ የባህር መስመሮች ላይ የሚፈጠሩ መስተጓጎሎች በሀብት የበለፀገችውን አፍሪካ ኢኮኖሚ በእጅጉ እየጎዱ ይገኛሉ። አፍሪካ ከዚህ ተፅዕኖ ለመውጣት ከመሬት ላይ ትኩረት ከሚያደርግ የፀጥታ ስልት ወደ አንድ የጋራ የባህር ጠረፍ ፖሊሲ መቀየር አለባት። አህጉሪቱ ታሪካዊ ልዩነቶቿን በማሸነፍ ሀብቷን በማቀናጀት ከቀጥተኛ የሀብት አቅራቢነት ወደ ዓለም አቀፍ የጂኦፖለቲካ ተዋናይነት መሸጋገር ትችላለች።
oromo: Rakkoon daandii galaana Hormuz irratti uumame diinagdee Afrikaa kan miidhe yoo ta'u, kunis qabeenya uumamaa qabaattee jirattus biyyoonni Afrikaa guutummaatti gabaa alaarratti hirkachuu isaaniti. Afrikaan rakkoo kana keessaa bahuuf, xiyyeeffannoo ishee lafarratti qofa gochuu dhiistee imaammata galaana waloo cimaa diriirsuu qabdi. Biyyoonni Afrikaa walitti dhufuun karoora tokko yoo hordofan, gabaa qofatti hirkachuu dhiisanii humna guddaa geopolitics addunyaa ta'uu danda'u.

title: Mohamed Salah’s Trabzonspor debut ends in draw with Kasimpasa
english: Mohamed Salah made his debut for the Turkish club Trabzonspor during a 1-1 draw against Kasimpasa in their league opener. The Egyptian star came on as a substitute early in the second half but was unable to help his new team secure a victory. The club's coach expressed disappointment with the result as they now turn their attention to an upcoming Europa League match.
amharic: ሙሐመድ ሳላህ ለቱርኩ ክለብ ትራብዞንስፖር በሊጉ የመክፈቻ ጨዋታ ከካሲምፓሳ ጋር አንድ አቻ በሆነ ውጤት የመጀመሪያ ጨዋታውን አድርጓል። የግብፁ ኮከብ በሁለተኛው አጋማሽ ተቀይሮ ወደ ሜዳ ቢገባም አዲሱ ቡድኑ ድል እንዲቀናጅ ማድረግ አልቻለም። የቡድኑ አሰልጣኝ በውጤቱ መበሳጨታቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ አሁን ትኩረታቸው ወደሚቀጥለው የኢሮፓ ሊግ ጨዋታ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Mohamed Saalaah kilabii Tarkii Traabzoonspoorif tapha jalqabaa isaatiin, Kasimpaasaa wajjin tapha 1-1 ta'een xumure. Gochaan biyya Gibxii kun harka lammaffaa irratti bakka bu'ee gara dirree seenus, garee isaa haaraa injifannoo gonfachiisuu hin dandeenye. Leenji'aan garee kanaa bu'aa kanaan gadda isaa kan ibse yoo ta'u, amma xiyyeeffannoon isaanii tapha Yuurooppa Liigii dhufu irratti ta'a.

title: Iranian military promises 'complete defeat' of Israel and US
english: The Iranian military leadership has publicly vowed to achieve the total defeat of both Israel and the United States. High-ranking officials claim that the country's missile and air defense manufacturing capabilities remain largely unaffected by ongoing conflicts. Furthermore, they assert that the production of these military systems continues at pre-war levels while passing the values of resistance to younger generations.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ አመራሮች እስራኤልን እና አሜሪካን ሙሉ በሙሉ እንደሚያሸንፉ ቃል ገብተዋል። ከፍተኛ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ አገሪቱ ያላት የሚሳይል እና የአየር መከላከያ መሳሪያዎች የማምረት አቅም በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ምንም ጉዳት አልደረሰበትም። በተጨማሪም፣ የወታደራዊ መሳሪያዎች ምርት እንደ ቀድሞው በከፍተኛ ደረጃ እየቀጠለ መሆኑን እና የተቃውሞ መንፈስ ለአዲሱ ትውልድ እየተላለፈ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Iraan Israa'elii fi Ameerikaa guutummaatti akka mo'atan waadaa galaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa biyyattii akka jedhanitti, dandeettiin Iraan meeshaalee gurguddaa fi ittisa qilleensaa oomishuuf qabdu waraana kana keessatti miidhaan guddaan irra hin geenye. Kana malees, oomishni meeshaalee waraanaa akkuma kanaan duraa itti fufeera, akkasumas aadaan diddaa dhaloota haaraaf dabarsaa jiraachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Germany has chosen Israel over international law
english: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has faced criticism for prioritizing support for Israel over adherence to international law and his own country's democratic principles. Critics, including intellectual Navid Kermani, argue that the Chancellor's willingness to disregard international legal obligations and support extreme actions sets a dangerous precedent. This approach is seen as a threat to both global justice and the integrity of Germany’s own internal democracy.
amharic: የጀርመን ቻንስለር ፍሪድሪክ ሜርዝ ከአለም አቀፍ ህግ ይልቅ እስራኤልን በመደገፋቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበባቸው ነው። እንደ ናቪድ ኬርማኒ ያሉ ምሁራን፣ ቻንስለሩ አለም አቀፍ የህግ ግዴታዎችን ችላ ማለታቸው ለጀርመን ዲሞክራሲም ጭምር አደገኛ አዝማሚያ መሆኑን ይከራከራሉ። ይህ አካሄድ ለዓለም አቀፍ ፍትህ እና ለጀርመን የውስጥ ዲሞክራሲ እሴቶች ስጋት እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Kantolarri Jarmanii Friedrich Merz, seera idil-addunyaa kabajuu mannaa Israa'el gargaaruu filachuun isaanii qeeqa cimaaf isaan saaxilee jira. Akka hayyuun Navid Kermani jedhutti, tarkaanfiin kun kan seera idil-addunyaa tuffatuufi bu'uura dimokraasii biyyattii miidhuu danda'u dha. Haalli kun seeraa fi haqa idil-addunyaa irratti qofa osoo hin taane, dimokraasii ofii isaanii irrattis miidhaa geessisuu akka danda'u hubachiifamee jira.

title: Live video captures panic as gunman opens fire at park in Kentucky
english: A shooting incident occurred at a park in Lexington, Kentucky, which was inadvertently captured on a live video stream. The attack resulted in one death and left four individuals injured, including two children. Local authorities are investigating the violence that caused immediate panic among those present at the scene.
amharic: በኬንታኪ ግዛት ሌክሲንግተን በሚገኝ መናፈሻ ውስጥ በተከሰተ የተኩስ ልውውጥ አንድ ሰው ሲሞት አራት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል ሁለት ህጻናት እንደሚገኙበት ተዘግቧል። ይህ አስደንጋጭ ክስተት በወቅቱ በነበረ የቀጥታ የቪዲዮ ስርጭት ላይ ተመዝግቧል።
oromo: Magaalaa Leksingtan, kanneen keessatti argamu paarkii tokko keessatti namni hidhattee tokko dhukaasa banuun lubbuun nama tokko darbeera. Miidhaa kanaan ijoollee lama dabalatee namoonni afur madaa’aniiru. Gochi kun viidiyoo qophii qajee (live) ta’e irratti kan waraabame yoo ta’u, yeroo ammaa qulqulluun isaa qoratamaa jira.

title: Cincinnati Open: Djokovic stunned by Tirante in second round
english: Novak Djokovic was unexpectedly eliminated from the Cincinnati Open in the second round by Thiago Tirante. The tennis legend struggled significantly with the intense heat and humidity throughout the challenging match, which lasted over two and a half hours. Despite a strong start, Djokovic eventually lost in three sets during his first competitive appearance since Wimbledon.
amharic: ኖቫክ ጆኮቪች በሲንሲናቲ ክፍት የቴኒስ ውድድር ሁለተኛ ዙር ላይ ባልተጠበቀ ሁኔታ በቲያጎ ቲራንቴ ተሸንፎ ከውድድሩ ውጪ ሆኗል። ከዊምብልደን በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ሜዳ የቀረበው ሰርቢያዊው ኮከብ፣ በውድድሩ ወቅት በነበረው ከፍተኛ ሙቀት እና እርጥበት ክፉኛ ተቸግሮ ነበር። ከሁለት ሰዓት ተኩል በላይ የፈጀው ይህ ጨዋታ በጆኮቪች ሽንፈት ተጠናቋል።
oromo: ኖቫክ ጆኮቪች ውድድር ሲንሲናቲ ኦፕን irratti nama hin yaadatamne Thiago Tirante irratti injifatamee sadarkaa lammaffaa irratti geggeeffame. Taphatichi beekamaan kun tapha kana irratti ho'aafi jiidha qilleensaa cimaa mudateen rakkattee ture. Tapha sa'aatii lamaafi walakkaa oliif turte booda, erga Wimbledon booda tapha jalqabaa godhateen injifatamee ba'eera.

title: 3-year-old girl rescued 100 hours after Colombia earthquake
english: A three-year-old girl and a 75-year-old man were successfully rescued in Colombia after being trapped for over 100 hours following a devastating earthquake. Despite passing the usual 72-hour survival window, emergency crews pulled them safely from the debris. Search efforts remain active as teams continue to look for over 300 individuals who are currently reported as missing.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ በተከሰተው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ የፈራረሰው ህንጻ ውስጥ ተይዘው የነበሩ የሶስት ዓመት ህጻን እና የ75 ዓመት አዛውንት ከ100 ሰአታት በኋላ በህይወት ተረፈው ተገኙ። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች የተለመደው የ72 ሰዓታት የህልውና ጊዜ ቢያልፍም ሁለቱንም ከፍርስራሹ ውስጥ ማውጣት ችለዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ከ320 በላይ የጠፉ ሰዎችን የመፈለግ ስራ አሁንም ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Kolombiyaatti lafti erga socho'ee booda ijoolleen waggaa sadii fi maanguddoon waggaa 75 ta'an, sa'aatii 100 ol erga diigama jala turanii booda lubbuun hafan. Gareen fannisuu hatattamaa, yeroo amalaan namoonni lubbuun itti hafan kan sa'aatii 72 darbee jiraatus, isaan kana diigama keessaa baasuu danda'aniiru. Yeroo ammaa kana namoota 320 ol ta'an kanneen bade barbaaduun ittifamee jira.

title: At least 12 people killed in Hungary bus crash
english: A Polish tourist bus traveling from Serbia crashed into a ditch and overturned on a highway in eastern Hungary, resulting in the deaths of at least 12 passengers. Ten people sustained serious injuries, while dozens more received treatment for minor wounds after rescue teams worked to pull trapped survivors from the wreckage. Local authorities have detained the driver, suspecting that he fell asleep at the wheel before the vehicle veered off the road.
amharic: ከሰርቢያ ወደ ፖላንድ በመጓዝ ላይ የነበረ የፖላንድ የቱሪስት አውቶቡስ በሃንጋሪ ሀይዌይ ላይ ገደል ውስጥ በመውደቁ ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው በደረሰበት ወቅት አስር ሰዎች ከባድ ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን ሌሎች ብዙዎች ደግሞ ቀላል ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ይገኛል። የሃንጋሪ ባለስልጣናት አሽከርካሪው መኪናውን እየነዳ ሳለ እንቅልፍ በመውሰዱ አደጋው እንደተከሰተ በመጠርጠር በቁጥጥር ስር አውለውታል።
oromo: Buusii turistoota Poolandiirraa gara Serbiyaa imalaa ture kan biyya Hangarii keessatti karaa irraa gadi bahee garagaleen namoonni 12 du'aniiru. Balaa kanaan namoonni kudhan miidhaa cimaan irra gaheera, namoonni biroos miidhaa salphaa irra gaheef wal'aansa argachaa jiru. Abbootiin taayitaa Hangarii akka jedhanitti, balaan kun kan uumame ooftuun buusiichaa osoo oofu hirriibni fudhatee karaa irraa bahee waan gadi galeefidha; ooftuunis ammaan tana to'annaa poolisi jala jira.

title: Photos: Patriotic music and flags mark Taliban rule anniversary in Kabul
english: The Taliban recently celebrated five years of their return to power with large gatherings in Kabul, showcasing their control through military parades and patriotic displays. While leaders claimed success in establishing sovereignty and security, many citizens continue to struggle with severe economic hardship, unemployment, and restricted freedoms. International isolation and ongoing humanitarian crises remain significant challenges for the country despite the group's efforts to seek global recognition.
amharic: ታሊባን ወደ ስልጣን ከተመለሰ አምስት ዓመታት መሙላቱን ምክንያት በማድረግ በካቡል ከፍተኛ ድጋፍ የሚያሳይ ሰልፍ አድርጓል። ቡድኑ ሀገሪቱን ከውጭ ተጽዕኖ ነጻ በማውጣቱ እንደተሳካለት ቢገልጽም፣ በሀገሪቱ ያለው ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ፣ ስራ አጥነት እና የሰብአዊ መብት ገደቦች የብዙ ዜጎችን ህይወት አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ግን ለቡድኑ እስካሁን እውቅና አልሰጠም።
oromo: Taalibaan gara aangootti deebi'uu isaa waggaa shanaffaa ilaalchisee magaalaa Kaabul keessatti ayyaaneffannaa guddaa gaggeesseera. Hogganoonni garee kanaa nageenya fi bilisummaa biyyaa mirkaneessine jedhanii kan dubbatan ta'us, uummanni hedduun garuu rakkoo dinagdee, hojii dhabdummaa fi mirga namoomaa irratti daangaa kaa'ameef komataa jiru. Dhiibbaan diinagdee fi adda ba’uu biyyattii addunyaa irraa itti fufee jira.

title: Douglass breaks 50m freestyle swimming world record, Ledecky loses 800m
english: At the 2026 Pan Pacific Swimming Championships, Australian swimmer Lani Pallister achieved a major upset by defeating American icon Katie Ledecky in the 800m freestyle. This loss marks a rare defeat for Ledecky, who has dominated the event for over a decade. Meanwhile, American swimmer Kate Douglass made history by breaking the 50m freestyle world record twice during the competition.
amharic: በ2026 በፓን ፓሲፊክ ዋና ሻምፒዮና ላይ አውስትራሊያዊቷ ላኒ ፓሊስተር በአሜሪካዊቷ የዋና ኮከብ ኬቲ ሌዴኪ ላይ በ800 ሜትር ነፃ ዋና ውድድር አስገራሚ ድል ተቀዳጅታለች። ይህ ውጤት ከዓመታት በላይ በዚሁ ውድድር ስትቆጣጠር የነበረችውን ሌዴኪን ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በዋና ዓለም አቀፍ መድረክ ተሸናፊ አድርጓታል። በተመሳሳይ ውድድር፣ አሜሪካዊቷ ኬት ዳግላስ በ50 ሜትር ነፃ ዋና የዓለም ክብረ ወሰንን በሁለት ጊዜ በማሻሻል ታሪክ ሰርታለች።
oromo: Bu'uura qophii dorgommii daakkoo Paan Paasifik bara 2026 irratti, daakkoon Awustiraaliyaa Laanii Paalistar badhaadheetti beekamtuu Ameerikaa Keetii Leedekii dorgommii daakkoo meetira 800 irratti injifatteetti. Leedekiin waggoota hedduuf dorgommii kana irratti injifannoo gonfattee kan turte yoo ta'u, injifannoon Paalistar kunis milkaa'ina guddaa ta'eera. Gammachuu biraatiin, Keet Daaglaas daakkoon Ameerikaa dorgommii meetira 50 irratti rekodii addunyaa yeroo lama jijjiiruun seenaa hojjatteetti.

title: Israeli police ease restrictions on Jewish prayer in Al-Aqsa compound
english: Israeli police have relaxed regulations at the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound by permitting Jewish worshippers to carry prayer books onto the site. This development follows a previous decision to allow the use of prayer sheets during visits. These actions contradict the existing status quo agreement, which is managed by the Jordanian Waqf.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፖሊስ በአል-አቅሳ መስጊድ ግቢ ውስጥ አይሁዳውያን ጸሎት የሚያደርጉበትን ህግ በማላላት የጸሎት መጽሐፍትን ይዘው እንዲገቡ ፈቅዷል። ከዚህ ቀደም የጸሎት ወረቀቶችን ይዘው እንዲገቡ ተፈቅዶላቸው የነበረ ሲሆን አሁን ደግሞ መጽሐፍትን እንዲጠቀሙ ተወስኗል። ይህ ውሳኔ በዮርዳኖስ ዋቅፍ የሚተዳደረውን የቆየውን ስምምነት የሚጥስ ነው።
oromo: Poolisiin Israa'el ganda Masjiida Al-Aqsaa keessatti namootni amantii Yihuudii kadhannaa akka gaggeeffatanif seera jiru laaffisuun, kitaabilee kadhannaatu gara bakkeetti akka galfamu hayyameera. Kanaan dura waraqaa kadhannaatu hayyamamee ture, amma garuu kitaabni guutuun akka fayyadaman murtaa'eera. Tarkaanfiin kun waliigaltee duraan turee fi bulchiinsa Waqfii Yordaanos jala jiru kan cabsuudha.

title: Israel threatens fresh attacks on Lebanon
english: Israel's Defense Minister has vowed to continue military strikes in southern Lebanon following a recent operation that left at least 11 people dead and 19 injured. He stated that the country will respond aggressively to any threats posed to its soldiers or civilians. This commitment highlights a potential escalation in the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎችን የገደለ እና 19 ሰዎችን ያቆሰለ ጥቃት ካደረሱ በኋላ ተጨማሪ ጥቃቶችን እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል። ወታደሮቻቸውን ወይም ዜጎቻቸውን በሚጎዱ አካላት ላይ ሙሉ ኃይላቸውን በመጠቀም እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ በቀጠናው ያለው ግጭት ተባብሶ ሊቀጥል እንደሚችል ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Israa'el erga haleellaa Kibba Libaanoositti namoota 11 ajjeeseefi 19 madoomsiise booda, haleellaa kana itti fufuuf waadaa galeera. Waraana isaanii ykn lammiilee isaanii irratti miidhaa geessisu kamiyyuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf akka qophaayan ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa gara fuulduraatti daran hammaachuu akka danda’u agarsiisa.

title: Australia to begin gun buyback scheme in response to Bondi shooting
english: Following a tragic shooting incident in Sydney last year, the Australian government has announced a new gun buyback program set to launch in New South Wales this November. Residents who voluntarily surrender their handguns or rifles to authorities will be eligible for financial compensation of up to $700 per weapon. This initiative aims to reduce the number of firearms in the community as part of a broader effort to enhance public safety.
amharic: ባለፈው ዓመት በሲድኒ በተከሰተው አሳዛኝ የተኩስ አደጋ ምክንያት፣ የአውስትራሊያ መንግስት በህዳር ወር በኒው ሳውዝ ዌልስ የሚተገበር አዲስ የጦር መሳሪያ ማስረከቢያ መርሃ ግብር ይፋ አድርጓል። ነዋሪዎች ሽጉጦቻቸውን እና ጠመንጃዎቻቸውን ለመንግስት ሲያስረክቡ ለእያንዳንዱ መሳሪያ እስከ 700 የአሜሪካ ዶላር ካሳ ያገኛሉ። ይህ ፕሮግራም የህዝብ ደህንነትን ለማረጋገጥ እና በማህበረሰቡ ውስጥ ያሉ የጦር መሳሪያዎችን ቁጥር ለመቀነስ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Mudannoo dhukaasaa waggaa darbe magaalaa Siidniitti raawwatamee ture hordofee, mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa sagantaa meeshaa waraanaa deebisiisuu ji'a Sadaasaa keessa Niiwu Saawuz Weelsitti jalqabamuuf qophaa'eera. Namoonni meeshaa isaanii fedhiidhaan mootummaatti kennan tokkoon tokkoo meeshaa isaaniitiif hanga doolaara Ameerikaa 700 argachuu danda'u. Sagantaan kun nageenya hawaasaa mirkaneessuufi meeshaalee waraanaa harka namootaa jiran hir'isuuf kaayyeffateera.

title: Three killed as Russia launches fresh aerial attacks across Ukraine
english: A recent wave of Russian aerial strikes across Ukraine has resulted in at least three deaths and over a dozen injuries, affecting areas including Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, and Dnipropetrovsk. In response, Ukraine launched a significant drone attack against Russian territory, damaging a major warehouse near Moscow. Additionally, a Spanish fighter jet intercepted and destroyed a drone that briefly crossed into Romanian airspace during the heightened military activity.
amharic: በዩክሬን ከተሞች በተከፈተ የሩሲያ የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ከደርዘን በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ለዚህ ምላሽ ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ላይ ባደረሰችው የድሮን ጥቃት በሞስኮ አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ ትልቅ መጋዘን ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግጭት ተባብሶ በነበረበት ወቅት፣ አንድ የስፔን የጦር አውሮፕላን ወደ ሮማኒያ የአየር ክልል የገባን ድሮን መትቶ መጣሉ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaa magaalota Ukreyn gara garaa irratti haleellaa qilleensaa geggeesseen namootni sadii du'anii, kudhanii ol madaa'aniiru. Akkaataa wal-falmii kanaan, Ukreyn gamashee Ruusiyaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) cimaa geggeessuun, magaalota Moskoo biratti bakka meeshaalee kuusu tokko miidhuu dandeesseetti. Gama biraatiin, waraanni kun hammaachaa jiruttis, xiyyaarri waraanaa Ispeen tokko gara qilleensa biyya Roomeeniyaatti seenee ture rukutee kuseera.

title: Lionel Messi misses penalty as Nashville thrash Inter Miami in MLS
english: Inter Miami suffered a 4-1 defeat against Nashville in a Major League Soccer match on Saturday. Lionel Messi missed a penalty kick and received a yellow card, although he did provide the assist for his team's only goal. With this victory, Nashville extended their home unbeaten streak and strengthened their lead at the top of the MLS standings.
amharic: ኢንተር ማያሚ በሜጀር ሊግ ሶከር በተደረገ ጨዋታ ናሽቪልን በመግጠም 4 ለ 1 በሆነ ውጤት ተሸንፏል። ሊዮናል ሜሲ የፍጹም ቅጣት ምት መቶ ያመከነ ሲሆን ቢጫ ካርድም ተመልክቷል፤ ሆኖም ለቡድኑ ብቸኛ ግብ አመቻችቶ አቀብሏል። በዚህ ድል ናሽቪል በሜዳው የነበረውን አሸናፊነት በማስቀጠል በሊጉ የደረጃ ሰንጠረዥ አናት ላይ ያለውን የበላይነት አጠናክሯል።
oromo: Inter Miami tapha Major League Soccer irratti Nashville waliin godheen 4-1n injifatameera. Lionel Messi adabbii biyyoolessaa (penalty) kan balleesse yoo ta'u, kaardii keelloos fudhateera, garuu goolii tokkicha garee isaa argameef qooda fudhateera. Injifannoo kanaan, Nashville gabaa manaa isaa irratti mo'atamuu kan hin dandeenye ta'uun itti fufeera akkasumas sadarkaa duraa MLS irratti dursu isaa cimseera.

title: New satellite images show Europe’s disappearing rivers due to drought
english: Severe drought conditions are currently affecting half of Europe, causing major rivers like the Rhine, Danube, and Loire to drop to record-low water levels. Recent satellite imagery confirms that this prolonged heat and dryness is drying out river channels and turning previously green agricultural lands brown. Experts warn that these environmental changes are widespread, impacting countries across Central and Western Europe significantly.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ግማሽ ያህሉ በከባድ ድርቅ በመጠቃቱ እንደ ራይን፣ ዳኑብ እና ሎየር ያሉ ዋና ዋና ወንዞች የውሃ መጠን ወደ ተመዘገበው ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ ወርዷል። የሳተላይት ምስሎች እንደሚያሳዩት የረዥም ጊዜ ሙቀት እና ደረቅ የአየር ሁኔታ የወንዞችን አልጋዎች በማድረቅ ቀድሞ የነበሩ ለምለም የግብርና መሬቶችን ወደ ቡናማነት ቀይሯቸዋል። ባለሙያዎች እንደገለጹት ይህ የአካባቢ መራቆት በአውሮፓ ማዕከላዊ እና ምዕራባዊ ክፍሎች ላይ ሰፊ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gama biraa, gogiinsi cimaan biyyoota Awurooppaa gariirra ga’e laggeen gurguddoo akka Rhine, Danube fi Loire sadarkaa gad-aanaa akka ga’an taasiseera. Suuroonni saatalaayitii akka agarsiisaniitti, hongeen kun laggeen gogsuu fi lafa magariisa ture gara lafa gogaa ykn bunniitti jijjiiruun oomisha qonnaarratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jira. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, jijjiiramni kun biyyoota Awurooppaa giddugaleessaa fi dhihaa keessatti babal’atee miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jira.

title: Ethiopia’s National Dialogue Could Unravel the Federal Bargain
english: Ethiopia has launched a National Dialogue aimed at addressing long-standing political tensions, but representatives from the Somali Region are concerned about its true objectives. They fear the process might be used to weaken the current federal system and constitutional protections that currently guarantee their regional autonomy. While Somalis feel the existing federal model has been poorly implemented, they view these constitutional safeguards as essential to prevent national marginalization.
