title: UFC 330: Makhachev secures record-setting win against Machado Garry
english: Islam Makhachev successfully defended his UFC welterweight title against Ian Machado Garry at UFC 330 in Philadelphia. With this unanimous decision victory, Makhachev achieved a record-breaking 17th consecutive win, surpassing the previous mark held by Anderson Silva. Additionally, Mackenzie Dern retained her women’s strawweight championship by defeating Gillian Robertson through dominant grappling.

oromo: Islaam Maakaachiv magaalaa Filaadelifiyaa keessatti dorgommii UFC 330 irratti Iyan Maachaadoo Gaarii injifachuun qabxii ዌልተር ዌይት isaa kabachiifateera. Injifannoo kanaan Maakaachiv mo'icha walitti aansee 17 galmeessisuun seenaa haaraa hojjateera; kunis rekoodii duraan Anderseen Siilvaan qabamee ture kan caaledha. Kana malees, Maakeenzii Dern dorgommii dubartootaa irratti Giiliyaan Roobertsoon injifachuun qabxii ishee itti fufteetti.

title: Bangladesh make history with first-ever Test cricket win in Australia
english: Bangladesh achieved a historic milestone by defeating Australia in a Test cricket match on Australian soil for the first time. The visitors dominated the top-ranked hosts in Darwin, securing a comfortable nine-wicket victory within four days. All-rounder Mehidy Hasan Miraz was instrumental in the win, delivering a standout performance with both bat and ball to seal the upset.

title: Emirati academic's barbed tweet on Pakistan exposes UAE unease over Mecca pact
english: A prominent Emirati political analyst recently criticized Pakistan on social media, questioning its ability to form a mutual defense pact with Saudi Arabia given its domestic economic and social challenges. This public criticism highlights growing unease within the UAE regarding the strategic security agreement between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey. The remarks sparked significant backlash from social media users who defended Pakistan's sovereignty and questioned the analyst's consistency.

title: Settler violence: 60-year-old man among two Palestinians shot, eight beaten
english: Israeli settlers, supported by military forces, attacked Palestinian residents in Hebron, resulting in two individuals being shot and eight others suffering injuries from physical assaults. Among those targeted were a 60-year-old man who was shot and an elderly woman who was beaten. Additionally, Israeli authorities issued new home eviction orders in Jerusalem and conducted detention raids in villages near Bethlehem.

title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
english: A Polish tourist bus crashed and overturned into a ditch along a Hungarian motorway early Sunday, resulting in the deaths of 12 passengers. Authorities suspect the driver fell asleep behind the wheel, leading to his arrest. Dozens of other people were injured in the accident and are currently receiving medical treatment.

title: How a simple lighter has become the backbone of life in Gaza
english: In Gaza, simple cigarette lighters have become rare and extremely expensive due to the ongoing conflict, forcing families to rely on them for essential tasks like cooking and heating water. Because they are so hard to find, people must carefully maintain broken ones or share them with neighbors to start wood fires. This lack of access to a basic tool often leaves families unable to prepare hot meals or feed their children regularly.

Rakkoon meeshaa salphaa kana dhabuu, maatiin hedduun guyyootaaf nyaata ho'aa akka hin arganne isaan taasiseera.

title: A nation divided: What do Israelis want in October’s elections?
english: Israel's upcoming October 27 election is focused on internal debates regarding democratic norms, government legitimacy, and mandatory military service for ultra-Orthodox citizens, rather than traditional peace talks. While the memory of the October 7 conflict deeply influences the national psyche, Jewish voters are primarily divided over the current coalition's impact on state institutions and the civil service. Meanwhile, Palestinian citizens of Israel are focused on seeking relief from the ongoing violence and instability affecting their communities.
amharic: የቀድሞው የእስራኤል ምርጫ ትኩረት በዋናነት በዴሞክራሲያዊ ስርአቶች፣ በመንግስት ህጋዊነት እና በአልትራ-ኦርቶዶክስ ዜጎች ግዳጅ ወታደራዊ አገልግሎት ላይ ያተኮረ ነው። ከዚህ ቀደም የነበረው የሰላም ውይይት ተረስቶ፣ የአሁኑ ምርጫ በአገሪቱ ተቋማት እና በሲቪል ሰርቪስ ላይ ባለው የፖለቲካ ተጽእኖ ላይ የተከፋፈለ ነው። በሌላ በኩል፣ በእስራኤል የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን በአካባቢያቸው እየደረሰ ያለውን ሁከት እና አለመረጋጋት ለመቀነስ የሚረዳ መንግስት እንዲመጣ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።
oromo: Filannoon Israa'el kan gara fuulduraa kun mata duree siyaasaa keessoo, akkaataa bulchiinsa mootummaa fi tajaajila waraanaa namoota amantii cimaa hordofanii irratti kan xiyyeeffatuudha. Walitti bu'iinsi siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti bal'inaan kan mul'atu yoo ta'u, kunis mootummaan amma jiru dhaabbilee mootummaa fi tajaajila sivilii irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabu irratti kan hundaa'eedha. Gama biraatiin, lammiileen Israa'el kan ta'an Falasxeenonni rakkoo nageenyaa fi gidiraa naannawa isaanii mudatu irraa furmaata argachuuf hawwu.

title: Arab League condemns Israeli strikes on Lebanon as 'dangerous escalation'
english: The Arab League has strongly criticized recent Israeli airstrikes in Lebanon that resulted in 11 deaths and significant property destruction, labeling the event a risky escalation. The organization accused Israel of deliberately stalling peace efforts and warned that the fighting could expand further throughout the region. They are urging global leaders to intervene and force compliance with UN resolutions to stop the violence.
amharic: የአረብ ሊግ በሊባኖስ ላይ የተፈጸመውንና የ11 ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈውን የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት እንደ አደገኛ ውጥረት በመቁጠር አውግዞታል። ድርጅቱ እስራኤል የሰላም ድርድሮችን እያደናቀፈች እና ግጭቱን እያራዘመች ነው ሲል ከሷል። አለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ጣልቃ በመግባት የተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት ውሳኔዎችን በማስከበር ግጭቱ ወደ ሌሎች አካባቢዎች እንዳይዛመት እንዲያቆም ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Gamtaan Arabaa haleellaa qilleensa irraa Israa'el Libnaan keessatti raawwattee fi lubbuu namoota 11 galaafate mormii cimaan balaaleeffateera. Dhaabbatichi gochi kun waldhabdee biyyattii keessatti bal'achuu danda'uufi carraa nagaa gufachiisuu akka ta'e ibseera. Hawwasi addunyaa haleellaa kana dhaabsisee, Israa'el murtee gamtaa mootummoota gamtoomanii akka kabajju dhiibbaa gochuu akka qabu dhaammateera.

title: Israeli defence minister Katz says 'no account will remain unsettled'
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has vowed to hold all opposing forces accountable following intense military strikes in southern Lebanon that resulted in 11 deaths and significant property damage. The country has also intensified its offensive in Gaza, leading to further casualties. Additionally, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially dismissed a peace proposal suggested by Donald Trump.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ባደረሱት ጥቃት 11 ሰዎች መገደላቸውን ተከትሎ፣ በሁሉም ግንባሮች ያሉ ሂሳቦች እንደሚወራረዱ ተናግረዋል። እስራኤል በጋዛ ላይ የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ዳግም ያጠናከረች ሲሆን በዚህም ተጨማሪ የሰው ህይወት አልፏል። ከዚህም በላይ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የዶናልድ ትራምፕን የጋዛ የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz erga haleellaa Kibba Libaanoos irratti gaggeeffameen namoonni 11 erga du'anii booda, akkaataa itti gaafatamummaan hunda irratti fudhatamu ibsaniiru. Israa'el haleellaa Gaazaa irratti gaggeessitu daran kan jabeeffatte yoo ta'u, kunis lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafateera. Kana malees, Muummichi Ministiraa Beniyaamin Neetaan yaahuu karoora nagaa Gaazaaf Doonaald Tiraamp dhiyeessan fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru.

title: Indonesia’s magnitude 7.7 quake kills at least 51, displaces thousands
english: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Flores Island in eastern Indonesia, resulting in at least 51 deaths and hundreds of injuries. The disaster destroyed or damaged over 300 homes and forced approximately 5,000 residents to flee to temporary shelters. Emergency crews are currently navigating difficult terrain and landslides to provide aid to survivors as hundreds of aftershocks continue to shake the region.
amharic: በምስራቅ ኢንዶኔዥያ በምትገኘው ፍሎሬስ ደሴት ላይ የደረሰው ኃይለኛ 7.7 የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 51 ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን በርካቶችን አቁስሏል። አደጋው ከ300 በላይ ቤቶችን በማውደም ወይም በመጉዳት ወደ 5,000 የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አድርጓል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች የመሬት መንሸራተት ባስከተለው ችግር እና በተከታታይ በሚከሰቱ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦች ምክንያት ለተጎጂዎች እርዳታ ለማድረስ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Indooneziyaatti, naannoo sulula Flores jedhamutti, sochii lafaa cimaa hamma 7.7 ta'een lubbuun namoota 51 ol darbeera, namoonni hedduunis miidhamaniiru. Balaan kun mana jireenyaa 300 ol barbadeesse ykn miidhe, namoota 5,000 ta'an immoo manaa baasee iddoo buufata yerootti akka qubatan dirqisiiseera. Gareen gargaarsaa lafa isaan rakkise fi sochii lafaa itti fufe keessa darbuun namoota balaa kanaan miidhaman gargaaruuf tattaaffii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: Russian strikes kill Ukrainian woman as NATO jet downs drone over Romania
english: A recent Russian missile and drone attack on Ukraine resulted in one fatality and several injuries, including strikes in Kyiv and Kryvyi Rig. Simultaneously, a Spanish NATO fighter jet intercepted and destroyed an unidentified drone that violated Romanian airspace. This incident highlights the ongoing danger of the conflict spreading beyond Ukraine's borders as both sides continue to exchange drone attacks.
amharic: በዩክሬን ላይ የተፈጸመ የሩሲያ ሚሳኤል እና ድሮን ጥቃት የአንድ ሰው ህይወት ሲያልፍ ሰባት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ በሮማኒያ የአየር ክልል ውስጥ የገባ ማንነቱ ያልታወቀ ድሮን በኔቶ የጦር አውሮፕላን ተመትቶ ወድቋል። ይህ ክስተት የዩክሬን-ሩሲያ ጦርነት ከድንበር አልፎ በጎረቤት ሀገራት ላይ እያደረሰ ያለውን ተጽዕኖ ያሳያል።
oromo: Hojiin weerara isaa kan Raashiyaan Ukraayinii irratti raawwate lubbuu namoota tokkoo galaafatee, namoota biroo irratti ammoo miidhaa geessiseera. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, xiyyaarri waraana NATO kan Ispeen, xiyyaara nama malee balali'u (drone) kan daangaa biyya Roomeeniyaa cabsee seene rukutee kuseera. Gochi kun waraanni kun daangaa Ukraayinii darbee biyyoota ollaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jiraachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Israel strikes south Lebanon again as families flee north
english: Israel has launched new airstrikes in southern Lebanon, specifically targeting the Nabatieh district. These attacks occurred shortly after the region experienced its most lethal day of violence since the recent ceasefire. As a result, hundreds of residents are currently evacuating their homes and traveling north to escape the ongoing danger.
amharic: እስራኤል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የናባቲዬህ ወረዳ ላይ አዳዲስ የአየር ጥቃቶችን ፈጽማለች። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት በሊባኖስ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ከተደረገ በኋላ እጅግ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት የደረሰበት ቀን ማግስት ነው። በዚህም ሳቢያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤተሰቦች ከጦርነቱ ለመዳን ወደ ሰሜን በመሸሽ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Israa'el gammoojjii Kibba Liibaanoositti argamu naannoo Nabatiyeetti haleellaa xiyyaaraan raawwatteetti. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame guyyaa Liibaanoos keessatti gochi waraanaa hanga ammaatti cimaa ta'e erga raawwatamee sa'aatii muraasa booda dha. Haala kanaan wal qabatee, maatiiwwan hedduun balaa kana irraa lubbuu isaanii oolchuuf gara kaabaatti baqachaa jiru.

title: Australia gun buyback spurred by Bondi attack to start in November, PM says
english: Following a tragic mass shooting at Bondi Beach that claimed 15 lives, the Australian government is launching a new gun buyback program in New South Wales this November. Officials will offer financial compensation to citizens who voluntarily surrender their firearms to help reduce the record number of weapons currently in circulation. Additionally, the government is implementing stricter licensing requirements and addressing hate-motivated violence to enhance public safety.
amharic: ባለፈው ዓመት በቦንዲ ቢች በደረሰውና 15 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገውን አሰቃቂ ጥቃት ተከትሎ፣ የአውስትራሊያ መንግስት በኒው ሳውዝ ዌልስ ግዛት የሚተገበር የጦር መሳሪያ ማስረከቢያ መርሃ ግብር በህዳር ወር ይጀምራል። ይህ መርሃ ግብር ዜጎች በፈቃደኝነት የጦር መሳሪያዎቻቸውን በማስረከብ የገንዘብ ካሳ እንዲያገኙ በማድረግ፣ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለውን የጦር መሳሪያ ብዛት ለመቀነስ ያለመ ነው። በተጨማሪም መንግስት የህዝብን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ የመሳሪያ ፈቃድ አሰጣጥ ህጎችን በማጥበቅና በጥላቻ ላይ የተመሰረተ ጥቃትን ለመከላከል የሚያስችሉ እርምጃዎችን እየወሰደ ነው።
oromo: Hanga waggaa darbe bakka Bondi Beach jedhamutti namoota 15 ajjeese sanatti erga raawwatamee booda, mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa sagantaa meeshaa waraanaa itti deebisan kutaalee biyyattii keessaa tokko taate New South Wales keessatti ji'a Sadaasaa keessa akka jalqabu beekameera. Sagantaan kun lammiileen meeshaa waraanaa isaanii fedhii isaaniin akka deebisanii fi beenyaa maallaqaa akka argatan taasisuun, baay'ina meeshaa waraanaa biyyattii keessa jiru gadi hir'isuuf gargaara. Kana malees, mootummaan nageenya ummataa eeguuf jecha seera hayyama meeshaa waraanaa jiru cimsuu fi qabsoo jibbaan kaka'e ittisuuf tarkaanfiiwwan garaagaraa fudhachaa jira.

title: Israeli forces incur into Syria’s Quneitra, fire flares
english: Israeli military forces entered the Syrian town of Al-Rafid and launched flares that triggered a fire, which was later extinguished by local emergency teams. This incident is part of a broader pattern of regular Israeli military incursions into the Quneitra and Daraa regions since early 2024. These ongoing operations often involve residential raids and the detention of Syrian civilians within the border areas.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሶሪያ ኩኒትራ ክልል ወደምትገኘው አል-ራፊድ ከተማ በመግባት ባደረሱት የተኩስ ልውውጥ የተነሳ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ተከስቶ ነበር። አካባቢው የነበሩ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ማጥፋታቸውን የአካባቢው የመገናኛ ብዙሃን ዘግበዋል። ከ2024 መጀመሪያ ጀምሮ እስራኤል ወደ ተባበሩት መንግስታት ቁጥጥር ስር ወደሚገኘው ቀጠና በመግባት ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎችን እያደረገች ሲሆን፣ በተደጋጋሚ ቤት ለቤት ፍተሻ በማድረግ ሲቪሎችን እያሰረች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Al-Rafid kan naannoo Quneitra Siriyaa keessatti argamtu seenuun xiyya bifa bifa ibiddatti fayyadamuun isaan irraa ibiddi ka'eera. Ibiddi kunis garee gargaarsa ariifachiisaa naannichaan dhaamsameera. Israa'el bara 2024 jalqabee naannoo UN to'atu keessa seenuun qe'ee Siriyaa weeraruun, iddoowwan akka Quneitraa fi Daraa keessatti namoota nagaa hidhuu fi manaa manatti qorannoo geggeessuu itti fuftee jirti.

title: Yemeni government forces hit back after new Houthi offensive
english: Yemeni government forces, supported by Saudi Arabia, have launched counter-attacks against the Houthi movement following an increase in militant strikes. The Houthis recently intensified their efforts to seize control of key locations like the city of Marib and the port of Makha. This surge in violence has sparked significant concern that the region is sliding back into a widespread and destructive conflict.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ድጋፍ አማፂው የሁቲ ቡድን በወሰደው ጥቃት ምላሽ መስጠት ጀምረዋል። ሁቲዎች እንደ ማሪብ ከተማ እና የማካ ወደብ ባሉ ወሳኝ አካባቢዎች ጥቃታቸውን ማጠናከራቸውን ተከትሎ ግጭቱ ተባብሷል። ይህ የታደሰው የሁለቱ ወገኖች ግጭት አገሪቱ ወደ ሙሉ ጦርነት ልትመለስ ትችላለች የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yaman deeggarsa Saudii Arabiyaatiin, gareen Huutii weerara irratti banuun wal qabatee tarkaanfii deebii fudhachuu jalqabaniiru. Gareen Huutii kun magaalota gurguddoo fi buufata doonii Maakhaa dabalatee bakkeewwan tarsiimoo ta'an to'achuuf yaalii isaa jabeesseera. Gidduu kana kan dhalate walitti bu'iinsi kun, biyyattiin gara waraana guutuu fi hamataatti deebi'uu dandeessi soda jedhu hammaateera.

title: Who killed Tupac? What to know about the trial of Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis
english: Nearly 30 years after the tragic 1996 murder of iconic rapper Tupac Shakur, Duane 'Keffe D' Davis is facing trial in Las Vegas for orchestrating the attack. Prosecutors claim Davis provided the weapon used in the drive-by shooting, though he was not the one who fired the fatal shots. This trial marks the first time anyone has been legally charged for the rapper's death, potentially resolving decades of mystery surrounding the killing.
amharic: ታዋቂው ራፐር ቱፓክ ሻኩር በ1996 ከተገደለ ወደ 30 ዓመታት ገደማ በኋላ፣ ዱዌን 'ኬፌ ዲ' ዴቪስ የተባለ ግለሰብ ግድያውን በማቀነባበር በላስ ቬጋስ ለፍርድ ቀርቧል። አቃቤ ህጎች እንደሚሉት ዴቪስ በጥይት መደብደቡን ባይፈጽምም ለግድያው መጠቀሚያ የሆነውን መሳሪያ አቅርቧል። ይህ ክስ በራፐሩ ሞት ዙሪያ ለብዙ አሥርት ዓመታት የቆየውን ምስጢር ለመፍታት የመጀመሪያው የህግ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Erga weereraa beekamaa Tupac Shakur bara 1996 ajjeefame waggaa 30 booda, Duane 'Keffe D' Davis ajjechaa kana qindeessuudhaan magaalaa Las Veegasitti seera duratti dhiyaatee jira. Abbaan alangaa akka jedhutti, Davis rasaasa isatti dhukaafame sana ofiin hin dhukaasin malee, meeshaa ajjeechaa kanaaf oole dhiyeessuu isaa himata. Qormaanni kun du'a weertichaa kanaan walqabatee waggoota dheeraaf iccitii ta'ee ture furuuf tarkaanfii seeraa jalqabaati.

title: Observers say Zambia’s election marred by reports of intimidation, violence
english: International observers have expressed concern over reports of violence, intimidation, and the temporary suspension of vote counting during Zambia's recent presidential election. The delay was triggered by security threats and alleged attacks on polling staff, leading to tensions between President Hakainde Hichilema’s ruling party and the opposition. Election officials have since resumed the count, while monitor groups are calling for calm and transparency throughout the remainder of the process.
amharic: ዓለም አቀፍ ታዛቢዎች በዛምቢያ በተካሄደው የፕሬዝዳንት ምርጫ ወቅት በተፈጠረው ሁከት፣ ማስፈራራት እና ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ተቋርጦ በነበረው የድምፅ አቆጣጠር ላይ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። የድምፅ አቆጣጠሩ የቆመው በምርጫ ጣቢያዎች ላይ በተፈጠረ የጸጥታ ስጋት እና በምርጫ ሰራተኞች ላይ በደረሰ ጥቃት ምክንያት ሲሆን ይህም በገዢው ፓርቲ እና በተቃዋሚዎች መካከል ውጥረትን ቀስቅሷል። የምርጫ ኮሚሽኑ የድምፅ አቆጣጠሩ እንዲቀጥል ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ታዛቢዎችም ሂደቱ እስኪጠናቀቅ ድረስ ሁሉም ወገኖች በትዕግስት እና በሰላም እንዲጠባበቁ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hordoftoonni idil-addunyaa filannoo pirezidaantii Zambiyaa irratti kan mudate jeequmsa, doorsisaa fi yeroo gabaabaaf addaan citee ture lakkoofsa sagalee irratti yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru. Lakkoofsi sagalee kan dhaabbate balaa nageenyaa fi hojjettoota filannoo irratti miidhaan gahuun isaa erga himamee booda yoo ta'u, kunis mootummaa fi mormituu gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumee jira. Komishiniin filannoo lakkoofsa sagalee deebisee kan jalqabe yoo ta'u, hordoftoonni garuu hanga bu'aan dhumaa ifoomutti hundi keenya tasgabbaa'uu qabna jechuun waamicha dhiyeessaniiru.

title: Hamas delegation to hold talks on Gaza agreement in Cairo, report says
english: A high-level Hamas delegation has traveled to Cairo to meet with Egyptian officials to discuss the ongoing ceasefire efforts in Gaza. This diplomatic mission follows Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's recent rejection of a peace proposal suggested by US President Donald Trump. The talks aim to address security concerns and the future of the conflict in the Palestinian territory.
amharic: የሃማስ ከፍተኛ ልዑካን ቡድን በጋዛ ስለሚደረገው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ለመወያየት ካይሮ ገብተዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት የተደረገው የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የቀረበውን የሰላም ዕቅድ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። ቡድኑ ከግብፅ የደህንነት ባለስልጣናት ጋር በመገናኘት በግጭቱ እና በደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ ይመክራል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni ol-aanoo Hamas marii dhaabbii waraanaa Gaazaa irratti mari’achuuf gara Kaayiroo imalaniiru. Imalli kun kan godhame erga muummichi ministeera Israa’el Benyaamin Neetanyaahuu yaada nageenyaa kan pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Doolaard Tiraampin dhiyaate didanii boodadha. Gareen kunis qaamolee nageenyaa Gibxii waliin ta’uun waa’ee nageenyaa fi furmaata walitti bu’iinsichaa irratti kan mari’atan ta’a.

title: Several Palestinians injured as settlers continue attacks in West Bank
english: Israeli settlers have launched a wave of attacks across the West Bank, resulting in injuries to multiple Palestinians and significant damage to their property. These incidents include physical assaults, the vandalism of homes and vehicles, and the destruction of agricultural land. Reports indicate that these ongoing aggressions frequently occur under the protection or presence of Israeli security forces.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኙ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች በፈጸሙት ተከታታይ ጥቃት በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን ንብረታቸውም ወድሟል። ጥቃቶቹ አካላዊ ድብደባን፣ መኖሪያ ቤቶችንና ተሽከርካሪዎችን ማውደምን እንዲሁም የግብርና መሬቶችን መጉዳትን ያካትታሉ። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች አብዛኛውን ጊዜ በእስራኤል የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ጥበቃ ወይም ተሳትፎ እንደሚፈጸሙ የደረሱ ሪፖርቶች ያመለክታሉ።
oromo: Qondaaltoonni Israa'el naannoo Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti weerara gaggeessaniin Palastinoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru akkasumas qabeenyisaanii manca'eera. Miidhaan kun reebicha, manneenii fi konkolaataalee mancaasuu, akkasumas lafa qonnaa irratti miidhaa geessisuu kan dabalatuudha. Gabaasoonni akka agarsiisutti, haleellaan kun yeroo baay'ee humnoota nageenyaa Israa'el jalatti kan raawwatamuudha.

title: Iran and Oman defining a temporary route for now, Araghchi says
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi clarified that current discussions with Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz are strictly technical and focused on establishing new maritime routes. He emphasized that these logistical talks are independent of the broader political decision to fully reopen the waterway. Whether the Strait eventually reopens remains contingent upon the United States meeting specific external conditions.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ከኦማን ጋር እየተደረገ ያለው ድርድር የሆርሙዝ ባህርን የመርከብ መስመር የመለየት ቴክኒካዊ ጉዳይ ብቻ እንደሆነ ገለጹ። ይህ ውይይት የባህር መስመሩን ሙሉ በሙሉ ከመክፈት የፖለቲካ ውሳኔ ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌለው አስታውቀዋል። የሆርሙዝ ባህር መከፈት በዋነኝነት የተመካው አሜሪካ በሌሎች ስምምነቶች ላይ የገባችውን ቃል መፈጸም አለመፈጸም ላይ ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi, mariin Oomaan waliin taasifamaa jiru karaa markaboota galaana Hormuz keessa darban qindeessuuf kan gargaaru dhimma teeknikaa qofa akka ta'e ibsan. Mariin kun guutummaatti karaa galaanichaa banuuf murtoo siyaasaa irra jiru waliin walitti hidhata akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Dhimmi karaa galaana Hormuz banuu fi banuu dhabuu isaa kan murtaa'u, Ameerikaan haala biroo irratti galte tokko tokko yoo guutte qofa akka ta'e himaniiru.

title: Al Jazeera journalist opens beach cafe in the Gaza she loves
english: Hind Khoudary, a journalist for Al Jazeera, has launched a new beach cafe in Gaza as a way to reclaim a sense of normalcy amidst the ongoing conflict. She created this space to provide a safe environment where local residents can connect and find a moment of peace during difficult times. Through this initiative, she aims to preserve a cherished aspect of Gazan life despite the surrounding devastation.
amharic: የአልጀዚራ ጋዜጠኛ ሂንድ ኩዳሪ በጋዛ ውስጥ አዲስ የባህር ዳርቻ ካፌ ከፍታለች። ይህም በጦርነት ለተጎዳው አካባቢ ነዋሪዎች አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታዎች ቢኖሩም መገናኛ እና መረጋጋት የሚፈጥርበት ቦታ እንዲሆን ታስቦ የተዘጋጀ ነው። ጋዜጠኛዋ በዚህ ተግባሯ በጋዛ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን ባህል ለማስቀጠል እና ለህዝቡ ትንሽም ብትሆን ሰላማዊ ጊዜ ለመፍጠር ትጥራለች።
oromo: Gaazexeessituun Al Jazeera Hind Khoudary, magaalaa Gaazaatti kafee bakka bashannana qarqara galaanaa tokko banatteetti. Kafeen kun, yeroo waraanaafi rakkoo cimaa keessa jiran kanatti, ummanni wal arguufi xiqqoo ta'us tasgabbii argachuuf bakka itti fayyadaman ta'a jedhamee yaadameera. Tarkaanfiin kun, akkaataa jireenyaa durii Gaazaatti beekamu sana rakkoo waraanaafi diiggaa jiru cinaatti akkasumas lubbuun jiraachisuuf kan yaadameedha.

title: Houthis launch sixth ballistic missile at Marib city
english: Houthi forces recently conducted their sixth ballistic missile strike on the Yemeni city of Marib, resulting in significant property damage. These repeated attacks have severely endangered civilians, including those living in refugee camps and residential areas. Previous strikes in the region have already caused multiple injuries and destroyed homes, vehicles, and local businesses.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ማሪብ ከተማ ላይ ስድስተኛውን የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ተደጋጋሚ እየሆነ የመጣው ይህ ጥቃት በከተማዋ ለሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች እና ለተፈናቃዮች ካምፖች ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። ከዚህ ቀደም በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን የቤት ንብረቶችና ተሽከርካሪዎችም ወድመዋል።
oromo: Humni Hutiin magaalaa Ma'arib kan Yamanitti xiyyaara kombattuu (ballistic missile) ja'affaa harcaasee jira. Haleellaan deddeebi'ee gaggeeffamaa jiru kun jireenya namoota nagaa fi qubata godaantotaa balaa hamaa irra buusee jira. Haleellaa darban kanaan namootni hedduun miidhamaa fi qabeenyi namoota nagaa kanneen akka manaa fi konkolaataa barbadaa'anii jiru.

title: Explosions heard in Lebanon's Nabatieh as Israel continues strikes
english: Israel conducted new airstrikes in Lebanon's Nabatieh district, causing several explosions near the town of Kfar Reman. These raids occurred shortly after a separate series of attacks killed 11 people, marking the highest casualty count since the recent ceasefire. Tensions in the region remain significantly elevated following these latest military operations.
amharic: እስራኤል በሊባኖስ ናባቲህ ግዛት አዲስ የአየር ጥቃት የፈጸመች ሲሆን በከፋር ሬማን ከተማ አካባቢ በርካታ ፍንዳታዎች ተሰምተዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት 11 ሰዎችን የገደለው ቀደም ሲል ከተካሄደው የአየር ጥቃት በኋላ ነው። ይህ ሁኔታ በቅርቡ ከተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት የቀጠፈ ክስተት ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል።
oromo: Isiraa'el naannoo Naabaatiyeh kan Libaanoos keessatti haleellaa qilleensa irraa haaraa gaggeessiteen, magaalaa Kfar Reman biratti dhoohiinsi cimaan dhaga'ameera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame namoota 11 ajjeese erga haleellaa duraa raawwatamee booda. Kunis walii galtee waraana dhaabuu dhiheenya kana irra ga'amee booda balaa cimaa tasa uumame dha.

title: Opinion: How a pragmatic axis could reshape the Middle East
english: The Middle East is moving beyond its traditional power struggle between Iran's proxy network and the US-backed Israeli security framework. A new influential bloc, referred to as a Sunni axis, is beginning to take shape with leadership from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan. This shift suggests that the region's long-standing political dynamics are being fundamentally reorganized into a more complex three-part structure.
amharic: የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ከአሁን በፊት በነበረው የኢራን ተፅዕኖ እና በአሜሪካ-እስራኤል የደህንነት ማዕቀፍ መካከል የነበረውን ፍጥጫ እያለፈ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን የሚመሩት አዲስ የሱኒ ሀገራት ቡድን ብቅ እያለ ነው። ይህ ለውጥ የቀጠናው የረጅም ጊዜ የፖለቲካ አሰላለፍ ወደ ውስብስብ የሶስትዮሽ ቅርፅ እየተቀየረ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hala siyaasaa Baha Giddu galeessaa durii kan ture walitti bu'iinsa Iran fi tumsa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el darbee, ammaan tana gara caalaatti jijjiiramaa jira. Gareen biyyoota Sunniin durfamu kan akka Sa'udii Arabiyaa, Turkaayii fi Paakistaan walitti dhufeenyaan hundaa'aa jira. Jijjiiramni kun caasaa siyaasaa naannichaa kan durii sun gara caasaa sadetti kan qoodamee fi caalaatti walxaxaa ta'eetti jijjiiramaa jiraachuu agarsiisa.

title: Prosecutors Charge Seven Alleging Amhara Bank’s Credit Controls Bend for One Borrower
english: Federal prosecutors have filed corruption and abuse of power charges against seven individuals and a private company. The accused include several former high-ranking executives from Amhara Bank and the leadership of Zemera Investment Group. These charges stem from allegations that they illegally bypassed credit regulations in foreign trade deals, resulting in a loss of over 137 million Birr for the bank.
amharic: የፌደራል አቃቤ ህግ በአማራ ባንክ ላይ ከ137 ሚሊዮን ብር በላይ የገንዘብ ብክነት አድርሰዋል በሚል ሰባት ግለሰቦችና አንድ የግል ድርጅት ላይ ክስ መስርቷል። በተከሳሽነት የቀረቡት የባንኩ የቀድሞ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ የባንኩ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች እና የዜሜራ ኢንቨስትመንት ግሩፕ ኃላፊዎች ናቸው። ተከሳሾቹ በውጭ ንግድ ስምምነቶች ወቅት የብድር መመሪያዎችን በመጣስ ለሙስና እና ለስልጣን ያለአግባብ መጠቀም ተግባር ተጠያቂ መሆናቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa federaalaa namoota torbaafi dhaabbata dhuunfaa tokko irratti himata malaammaltummaafi aangoo gandaa fayyadamuu dhiyeesseera. Himatamtoota keessatti hooggantoonni olaanoo Baankii Amharaa duraanii fi hooggantoonni dhaabbata 'Zemera Investment Group' kan argaman yoo ta'u, isaanis waliigaltee daldala alaa keessatti seera baankii cabsuun qarshii miliyoona 137 ol baankicharraa akka bade shakkamu.

title: Addis Abeba Builds Over Its Waterways. Now the Floods Find a Way Back
english: Addis Ababa is facing severe flooding issues caused by urban development that has encroached upon natural waterways. The tragedy of an 11-year-old boy who went missing after falling into a hidden, uncovered drain highlights the dangerous consequences of poor city planning. Experts argue that the city's recurrent flooding is not a natural disaster but a direct result of design failures in its infrastructure.
amharic: የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር በተፈጥሯዊ የውሃ መተላለፊያ መንገዶች ላይ ግንባታዎችን ማከናወኑ ለከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ እየዳረገው ይገኛል። በጀሞ አካባቢ የ11 ዓመት ልጅ በጎርፍ ተሸፍኖ በነበረ ክፍት የውሃ ማፍሰሻ ውስጥ ወድቆ መጥፋቱ የከተማዋን ደካማ የመሠረተ ልማት ዝግጅት አጋልጧል። የከተማዋ ጎርፍ በተፈጥሮ የሚከሰት ሳይሆን የተሳሳተ የከተማ ፕላን ውጤት መሆኑን ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Magalaan Finfinnee bakka bishaan gadi ba'uuf uumamanii turan irratti ijaarsa gaggeessuun ishee lolaa hamaaf akka saaxilamtu ishee godheera. Mucaan waggaa 11 tokko iddoo lolaan haguugee ture keessatti bishaan duubatti awwaalame keessatti kufuu isaa fi baduun isaa, rakkoo karoora magaalichaa kan agarsiisuudha. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, lolaan magaalattii keessatti deddeebi'ee mudatu kun balaa uumamaa osoo hin taane, dogoggora ijaarsa magaalichaa irraa kan madde dha.

title: Ethio-post Turns Branches into Banks as Banks Close Theirs
english: Ethio-post is transforming its 3,000 nationwide branches into financial service hubs that allow customers to manage bank accounts, pay bills, and handle cash transactions. Working alongside the ET-switch payment network, the state postal service has already launched a pilot program in 700 locations. This initiative aims to modernize the historic institution by integrating it into the country's formal banking infrastructure within the next month.
amharic: ኢትዮ-ፖስት በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ ያሉትን 3,000 ቅርንጫፎቹን የባንክ አገልግሎት መስጫ ማዕከላት ለመቀየር እየተዘጋጀ ነው። ደንበኞች በቅርንጫፎቹ አማካኝነት ገንዘብ ማውጣትና ማስገባት፣ የፍጆታ ክፍያዎችን መፈጸም እንዲሁም የባንክ ሂሳቦቻቸውን ማስተዳደር ይችላሉ። የኢቲ-ስዊች ክፍያ መረብን በመጠቀም በ700 ቅርንጫፎች የሙከራ ስራ የጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ሙሉ በሙሉ ስራውን በአንድ ወር ጊዜ ውስጥ በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ ለማስጀመር ታቅዷል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa Poostaan dameewwan isaa 3,000 gara bakka tajaajila baankii kennuutti jijjiiruuf qophaa’aa jira. Tajaajilli kun maamiltoonni maallaqa akka baasan, galchan, kaffaltii tajaajilaa akka raawwatanii fi herreega baankii isaanii akka hogganan kan dandeessisuudha. Walitti hidhamiinsa marsaa kaffaltii 'ET-switch' fayyadamuun dameewwan 700 irratti hojiin qorannoo eegaleera; guyyoota soddoman dhufan keessattis tajaajilli kun guutuu biyyattii keessatti kan eegalu ta'a.

title: Minister Threatens to Blacklist Traders Who Break Export Deals
english: The Ethiopian Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration is implementing strict penalties to address a record number of broken export contracts. Foreign buyers who repeatedly default will be banned from trading with the country for one year, while local exporters face temporary suspension of their permits. Repeat offenders among local businesses will have their trading licenses permanently revoked.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ንግድና ቀጠናዊ ትስስር ሚኒስቴር የወጡ የውጭ ንግድ ውሎችን ባለማክበር የሚፈጸሙ ጥሰቶችን ለመቆጣጠር አዲስ ጠንካራ እርምጃዎችን እየወሰደ ነው። እንደ አዲሱ አሰራር፣ በተደጋጋሚ ውል የሚያፈርሱ የውጭ ገዢዎች ለአንድ ዓመት ከኢትዮጵያ ጋር እንዳይገበያዩ ይከለከላሉ። በአገር ውስጥ ያሉ ላኪዎችም የንግድ ፈቃዳቸው ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ታግዶ፣ ተደጋጋሚ ጥሰት በሚፈጽሙት ላይ ግን የንግድ ፈቃዳቸውን ሙሉ በሙሉ የመሰረዝ እርምጃ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Ministeerri Daldalaa fi Walitti Hidhamiinsa Naannawaa Itoophiyaa waliigaltee ergaa alaa cabsuu irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophaa'eera. Gurgurtoota biyya alaa waliigaltee irra deddeebi'anii cabsan irratti waggaa tokkoof daldala irratti hirmaachuu irraa dhorkaan kan jiraatu yoo ta'u, ergaa alaa ergitoota biyya keessaa irrattis hayyamni daldalaa isaanii yeroof ni uggurama. Daldaltoonni biyya keessaa irra deddeebi'anii waliigaltee cabsan hayyama daldalaa isaanii guutummaatti ni dhabu.

title: Supreme Court Widens Shield for Lawyers Fighting the VAT
english: The Federal Supreme Court has extended legal protection to lawyers across several regional states who are challenging a government directive to register for VAT. The court's appellate bench has issued a temporary injunction that prevents the Ministry of Finance from enforcing the tax registration requirement on these attorneys. This stay will remain in place until a final ruling determines whether the government's tax mandate is lawful.
amharic: የፌደራል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ለተጨማሪ የክልል ጠበቆች የተጨማሪ እሴት ታክስ ምዝገባን ከመፈጸም ነጻ የሚያደርግ ጊዜያዊ እገዳ ሰጥቷል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር የወጣውን መመሪያ በመቃወም ላይ ለሚገኙ ጠበቆች የሰጠውን ከለላ ወደ አማራ፣ ሲዳማ፣ ደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ እና ቤኒሻንጉል ጉሙዝ ክልሎች አስፍቷል። ይህ ትእዛዝ መመሪያው ህጋዊነት እስኪረጋገጥ ድረስ ተግባራዊ የሚሆን ይሆናል።
oromo: Mana murtii waliigalaa federaalaa abukaattoota naannolee garaagaraa keessa jiran kanneen dirqama galmee gibira dabalataa (VAT) mormaa jiranaf ittisa seeraa bal'iseera. Mana murtichaa ajaja yeroon abukaattoonni kunneen hanga murtii dhumaa argatutti gibira kaffaluu irraa bilisa akka ta'an murteesseera. Murtiin kun hanga seera qabeessummaan qajeelfama ministeera maallaqaa mirkanaa'utti kan itti fufu ta'a.
